20933.text: And your own sisters, Sodʹom and her dependent towns, will return to their former state, and Sa·marʹi·a and her dependent towns will return to their former state, and you yourself and your own dependent towns will return to YOUR former state.

20934.label: Ezekiel 16:56
20934.text: And Sodʹom your sister did not prove to be anything worth hearing about from your mouth in the day of your pride,

20935.label: Ezekiel 16:57
20935.text: before your own badness got to be exposed, just as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria and of all round about her, the daughters of the Phi·lisʹtines, those treating you with scorn on all sides.

20936.label: Ezekiel 16:58
20936.text: Your loose conduct and your detestable things, you yourself must bear them,’ is the utterance of Jehovah.”

20937.label: Ezekiel 16:59
20937.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘I also must do with you just as you have done, because you despised the oath in breaking [my] covenant.

20938.label: Ezekiel 16:60
20938.text: And I, I myself, must remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I must establish for you an indefinitely lasting covenant.

20939.label: Ezekiel 16:61
20939.text: And you will certainly remember your ways and feel humiliated when you receive your sisters, the ones older than you as well as the ones younger than you, and I shall certainly give them to you as daughters, but not owing to your covenant.’

20940.label: Ezekiel 16:62
20940.text: “‘And I, I myself, will establish my covenant with you; and you will have to know that I am Jehovah,

20941.label: Ezekiel 16:63
20941.text: in order that you may remember and actually be ashamed and you may no more come to have any reason to open [your] mouth because of your humiliation, when I make an atonement for you for all that you have done,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

20942.label: Ezekiel 17:1
20942.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

20943.label: Ezekiel 17:2
20943.text: “Son of man, propound a riddle and compose a proverbial saying toward the house of Israel.

20944.label: Ezekiel 17:3
20944.text: And you must say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “The great eagle, having great wings, with long pinions, full of plumage, which had color variety, came to Lebʹa·non and proceeded to take the treetop of the cedar.

20945.label: Ezekiel 17:4
20945.text: He plucked off the very top of its young shoots and came bringing it to the land of Caʹnaan; in a city of traders he placed it.

20946.label: Ezekiel 17:5
20946.text: Furthermore, he took some of the seed of the land and put it in a field for seed. As a willow by vast waters, as a willow tree he placed it.

20947.label: Ezekiel 17:6
20947.text: And it began to sprout and gradually became a luxuriantly growing vine low in height, inclined to turn its foliage inward; and as for its roots, they gradually came to be under it. And it finally became a vine and produced shoots and sent forth branches.

20948.label: Ezekiel 17:7
20948.text: “‘“And there came to be another great eagle, having great wings, and having large pinions, and, look! this very vine stretched its roots hungrily toward him. And its foliage it thrust out to him in order [for him] to irrigate it, away from the garden beds where it was planted.

20949.label: Ezekiel 17:8
20949.text: Into a good field, by vast waters, it was already transplanted, in order to produce boughs and to bear fruit, to become a majestic vine.”’

20950.label: Ezekiel 17:9
20950.text: “Say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Will it have success? Will not someone tear out its very roots and make its very fruit scaly? And must [not] all its freshly plucked sprouts become dry? It will become dry. Neither by a great arm nor by a multitudinous people will it have to be lifted up from its roots.

20951.label: Ezekiel 17:10
20951.text: And, look! although transplanted, will it have success? Will it not dry up completely, even as when the east wind touches it? In the garden beds of its sprout it will dry up.”’”

20952.label: Ezekiel 17:11
20952.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

20953.label: Ezekiel 17:12
20953.text: “Say, please, to the rebellious house, ‘Do YOU people actually not know what these things mean?’ Say, ‘Look! The king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and proceeded to take its king and its princes and bring them to himself at Babylon.

20954.label: Ezekiel 17:13
20954.text: Furthermore, he took one of the royal seed and concluded a covenant with him and brought him into an oath; and the foremost men of the land he took away,

20955.label: Ezekiel 17:14
20955.text: in order that the kingdom might become low, unable to lift itself up, that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

20956.label: Ezekiel 17:15
20956.text: But he finally rebelled against him in sending his messengers to Egypt, [for it] to give him horses and a multitudinous people. Will he have success? Will he escape, he who is doing these things, and who has broken a covenant? And will he actually escape?’

20957.label: Ezekiel 17:16
20957.text: “‘“As I am alive,” is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, “in the place of the king who put in as king the one that despised his oath and that broke his covenant, with him in the midst of Babylon he will die.

20958.label: Ezekiel 17:17
20958.text: And by a great military force and by a multitudinous congregation Pharʹaoh will not make him effective in the war, by throwing up a siege rampart and by building a siege wall, in order to cut off many souls.

20959.label: Ezekiel 17:18
20959.text: And he has despised an oath in breaking a covenant, and, look! he had given his hand and has done even all these things. He will not make his escape.”’

20960.label: Ezekiel 17:19
20960.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “As I am alive, surely my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken—I will even bring it upon his head.

20961.label: Ezekiel 17:20
20961.text: And I will spread over him my net, and he will certainly be caught in my hunting net; and I will bring him to Babylon and put myself on judgment with him there respecting his unfaithfulness with which he acted against me.

20962.label: Ezekiel 17:21
20962.text: And as regards all the fugitives of his in all his bands, by the sword they will fall, and the ones left remaining will be spread abroad even to every wind. And YOU people will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have spoken [it].”’

20963.label: Ezekiel 17:22
20963.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “I myself will also take and put some of the lofty treetop of the cedar; from the top of its twigs I shall pluck off a tender one and I will myself transplant [it] upon a high and lofty mountain.

20964.label: Ezekiel 17:23
20964.text: On the mountain of the height of Israel I shall transplant it, and it will certainly bear boughs and produce fruit and become a majestic cedar. And under it there will actually reside all the birds of every wing; in the shadow of its foliage they will reside.

20965.label: Ezekiel 17:24
20965.text: And all the trees of the field will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have abased the high tree, have put on high the low tree, have dried up the still-moist tree and have made the dry tree blossom. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken and have done [it].”’”

20966.label: Ezekiel 18:1
20966.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

20967.label: Ezekiel 18:2
20967.text: “What does it mean to YOU people that YOU are expressing this proverbial saying on the soil of Israel, saying, ‘Fathers are the ones that eat unripe grapes, but it is the teeth of the sons that get set on edge’?

20968.label: Ezekiel 18:3
20968.text: “‘As I am alive,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘it will no more continue to be YOURS to express this proverbial saying in Israel.

20969.label: Ezekiel 18:4
20969.text: Look! All the souls —to me they belong. As the soul of the father so likewise the soul of the son—to me they belong. The soul that is sinning —it itself will die.

20970.label: Ezekiel 18:5
20970.text: “‘And as regards a man, in case he happens to be righteous and he has executed justice and righteousness;

20971.label: Ezekiel 18:6
20971.text: on the mountains he did not eat and his eyes he did not raise to the dungy idols of the house of Israel, and his companion’s wife he did not defile and to a woman in her impurity he would not go near;

20972.label: Ezekiel 18:7
20972.text: and no man would he maltreat; the pledge that he took for indebtedness, he would return; nothing would he wrest away in robbery; to the hungry one he would give his own bread and the naked one he would cover with a garment;

20973.label: Ezekiel 18:8
20973.text: nothing would he give on interest and no usury would he take; from injustice he would draw back his hand; true justice he would execute between man and man;

20974.label: Ezekiel 18:9
20974.text: in my statutes he kept walking and my judicial decisions he kept in order to execute truth, he is righteous. He will positively keep living,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

20975.label: Ezekiel 18:10
20975.text: “‘And [if] one has become father to a son who is a robber, a shedder of blood, who has done the like of one of these things

20976.label: Ezekiel 18:11
20976.text: (but he himself has done none of these very things); in case he has eaten also upon the mountains, and his companion’s wife he has defiled;

20977.label: Ezekiel 18:12
20977.text: the afflicted and poor one he has maltreated; things he has wrested away in robbery, a pledged thing he would not return; and to the dungy idols he lifted up his eyes, a detestable thing is what he has done.

20978.label: Ezekiel 18:13
20978.text: On usury he has given, and interest he has taken, and he positively will not keep living. All these detestable things he has done. He will positively be put to death. On him his own blood will come to be.

20979.label: Ezekiel 18:14
20979.text: “‘And, look! one has become father to a son, who keeps seeing all the sins of his father that he has done, and he sees and does not do things like them.

20980.label: Ezekiel 18:15
20980.text: On the mountains he has not eaten, and his eyes he has not lifted up to the dungy idols of the house of Israel; his companion’s wife he has not defiled;

20981.label: Ezekiel 18:16
20981.text: and no man has he maltreated, no pledge has he seized, and nothing has he taken in robbery; to the hungry one he has given his own bread, and the naked one he has covered with a garment;

20982.label: Ezekiel 18:17
20982.text: from the afflicted one he has drawn back his hand; no usury and interest has he taken; my judicial decisions he has carried out; in my statutes he has walked; he himself will not die because of the error of his father. He will positively keep living.

20983.label: Ezekiel 18:18
20983.text: As for his father, because he committed outright defrauding, wrested something away in robbery of a brother, and whatever is not good he has done in the midst of his peoples, look! then he must die for his error.

20984.label: Ezekiel 18:19
20984.text: “‘And YOU people will certainly say: “Why is it that the son does not have to bear anything because of the error of the father?” Now as regards the son, justice and righteousness he has executed, all the statutes of mine he has kept and he keeps doing them. He will positively keep living.

20985.label: Ezekiel 18:20
20985.text: The soul that is sinning—it itself will die. A son himself will bear nothing because of the error of the father, and a father himself will bear nothing because of the error of the son. Upon his own self the very righteousness of the righteous one will come to be, and upon his own self the very wickedness of a wicked one will come to be.

20986.label: Ezekiel 18:21
20986.text: “‘Now as regards someone wicked, in case he should turn back from all his sins that he has committed and he should actually keep all my statutes and execute justice and righteousness, he will positively keep living. He will not die.

20987.label: Ezekiel 18:22
20987.text: All his transgressions that he has committed—they will not be remembered against him. For his righteousness that he has done he will keep living.’

20988.label: Ezekiel 18:23
20988.text: “‘Do I take any delight at all in the death of someone wicked,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘[and] not in that he should turn back from his ways and actually keep living?’

20989.label: Ezekiel 18:24
20989.text: “‘Now when someone righteous turns back from his righteousness and actually does injustice; according to all the detestable things that the wicked one has done he keeps doing and he is living, none of all his righteous acts that he has done will be remembered. For his unfaithfulness that he has committed and for his sin with which he has sinned, for them he will die.

20990.label: Ezekiel 18:25
20990.text: “‘And YOU people will certainly say: “The way of Jehovah is not adjusted right.” Hear, please, O house of Israel. Is not my own way adjusted right? Are not the ways of YOU people not adjusted right?

20991.label: Ezekiel 18:26
20991.text: “‘When someone righteous turns back from his righteousness and he actually does injustice and dies on account of them, for his injustice that he has done he will die.

20992.label: Ezekiel 18:27
20992.text: “‘And when someone wicked turns back from his wickedness that he has committed and proceeds to execute justice and righteousness, he is the one that will preserve his own soul alive.

20993.label: Ezekiel 18:28
20993.text: When he sees and he turns back from all his transgressions that he has done, he will positively keep living. He will not die.

20994.label: Ezekiel 18:29
20994.text: “‘And the house of Israel will certainly say: “The way of Jehovah is not adjusted right.” As for my ways, are they not adjusted right, O house of Israel? Are not the ways of YOU people the ones that are not adjusted right?’

20995.label: Ezekiel 18:30
20995.text: “‘Therefore each one according to his ways is how I shall judge YOU, O house of Israel,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘Turn back, yes, cause a turning back from all YOUR transgressions, and let nothing prove to be for YOU people a stumbling block causing error.

20996.label: Ezekiel 18:31
20996.text: Throw off from yourselves all YOUR transgressions in which YOU have transgressed and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit, for why should YOU die, O house of Israel?’

20997.label: Ezekiel 18:32
20997.text: “‘For I do not take any delight in the death of someone dying,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. ‘So cause a turning back and keep living, O YOU people.’”

20998.label: Ezekiel 19:1
20998.text: “And as for you, raise a dirge concerning the chieftains of Israel,

20999.label: Ezekiel 19:2
20999.text: and you must say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness among lions. She lay down in among maned young lions. She reared her cubs.

21000.label: Ezekiel 19:3
21000.text: “‘And gradually she brought up one of her cubs. A maned young lion is what he became, and he began to learn how to tear apart prey. He devoured even earthling man.

21001.label: Ezekiel 19:4
21001.text: And nations kept hearing about him. In their pit he was caught, and they proceeded to bring him by means of hooks to the land of Egypt.

21002.label: Ezekiel 19:5
21002.text: “‘When she got to see that she had waited [and] her hope had perished, then she took another of her cubs. As a maned young lion she put him forth.

21003.label: Ezekiel 19:6
21003.text: And he began to walk about in the midst of lions. A maned young lion is what he became. And he gradually learned how to tear apart prey. He devoured even earthling man.

21004.label: Ezekiel 19:7
21004.text: And he got to know his dwelling towers, and he devastated even their cities, so that the land was laid desolate and he filled it with the sound of his roaring.

21005.label: Ezekiel 19:8
21005.text: And nations all around from the jurisdictional districts began to set against him and got to spread over him their net. In their pit he was caught.

21006.label: Ezekiel 19:9
21006.text: Finally they put him in the cage by means of hooks and brought him to the king of Babylon. They got to bring him by means of hunting nets, in order that his voice might no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

21007.label: Ezekiel 19:10
21007.text: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by waters. A bearer of fruit and full of branches she became because of abundant water.

21008.label: Ezekiel 19:11
21008.text: And they came to be for her strong rods, meant for the scepters of rulers. And its height gradually became tall up among branches, and it got to be visible because of its tallness, because of the abundance of its foliage.

21009.label: Ezekiel 19:12
21009.text: But she was finally uprooted in fury. To the earth she was thrown, and there was an east wind that dried up her fruit. Her strong rod was torn off and became dry. Fire itself devoured it.

21010.label: Ezekiel 19:13
21010.text: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a waterless and thirsty land.

21011.label: Ezekiel 19:14
21011.text: And fire proceeded to come forth from [her] rod. It devoured her very shoots, her very fruit, and there proved to be in her no strong rod, no scepter for ruling. “‘That is a dirge, and it will become a dirge.’”

21012.label: Ezekiel 20:1
21012.text: Now it came about in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], on the tenth [day] of the month, [that] men from the elderly ones of Israel came in to inquire of Jehovah, and they proceeded to sit down before me.

21013.label: Ezekiel 20:2
21013.text: Then the word of Jehovah occurred to me, saying:

21014.label: Ezekiel 20:3
21014.text: “Son of man, speak with the elderly men of Israel, and you must say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Is it in order to inquire of me that YOU men are coming? ‘As I am alive, I will not be inquired of by YOU,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’

21015.label: Ezekiel 20:4
21015.text: “Will you judge them? Will you judge [them], O son of man? Cause them to know the detestable things of their forefathers.

21016.label: Ezekiel 20:5
21016.text: And you must say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “In the day of my choosing Israel, I also proceeded to lift up my hand [in an oath] to the seed of the house of Jacob and to make myself known to them in the land of Egypt. Yes, I proceeded to lift up my hand [in an oath] to them, saying, ‘I am Jehovah YOUR God.’

21017.label: Ezekiel 20:6
21017.text: In that day I lifted up my hand [in an oath] to them to bring them forth from the land of Egypt to a land that I had spied out for them, one flowing with milk and honey. It was the decoration of all the lands.

21018.label: Ezekiel 20:7
21018.text: And I went on to say to them, ‘Throw away, each one of YOU, the disgusting things of his eyes, and with the dungy idols of Egypt do not defile yourselves. I am Jehovah YOUR God.’

21019.label: Ezekiel 20:8
21019.text: “‘“And they began to rebel against me, and they did not consent to listen to me. The disgusting things of their eyes they did not individually throw away, and the dungy idols of Egypt they did not leave, so that I promised to pour out my rage upon them, in order to bring my anger to its finish upon them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

21020.label: Ezekiel 20:9
21020.text: And I went acting for the sake of my own name that [it] might not be profaned before the eyes of the nations in among whom they were, because I had made myself known to them before their eyes on bringing them forth from the land of Egypt.

21021.label: Ezekiel 20:10
21021.text: So I brought them forth from the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

21022.label: Ezekiel 20:11
21022.text: “‘“And I proceeded to give them my statutes; and my judicial decisions I made known to them, in order that the man who keeps doing them might also keep living by them.

21023.label: Ezekiel 20:12
21023.text: And my sabbaths I also gave to them, to become a sign between me and them, in order [for them] to know that I am Jehovah who is sanctifying them.

21024.label: Ezekiel 20:13
21024.text: “‘“But they, the house of Israel, rebelled against me in the wilderness. In my statutes they did not walk, and my judicial decisions they rejected, which, should the man keep doing, he will also keep living by them. And my sabbaths they profaned very much, so that I promised to pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, in order to exterminate them.

21025.label: Ezekiel 20:14
21025.text: But I acted for the sake of my own name that [it] might not be profaned before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them forth.

21026.label: Ezekiel 20:15
21026.text: And I myself also lifted up my hand [in an oath] to them in the wilderness, not to bring them into the land that I had given, one flowing with milk and honey, (it is the decoration of all the lands,)

21027.label: Ezekiel 20:16
21027.text: for the reason that they rejected my own judicial decisions; and as regards my statutes, they did not walk in them, and my sabbaths they profaned, because it was after their dungy idols that their heart was going.

21028.label: Ezekiel 20:17
21028.text: “‘“And my eye began to feel sorry for them [to keep me] from bringing them to ruin, and I did not make an extermination of them in the wilderness.

21029.label: Ezekiel 20:18
21029.text: And I proceeded to say to their sons in the wilderness, ‘In the regulations of your forefathers do not YOU walk, and their judgments do not YOU keep, and with their dungy idols do not YOU defile yourselves.

21030.label: Ezekiel 20:19
21030.text: I am Jehovah YOUR God. Walk in my own statutes, and keep my own judicial decisions and do them.

21031.label: Ezekiel 20:20
21031.text: And sanctify my own sabbaths, and they must serve as a sign between me and YOU, [for YOU] to know that I am Jehovah YOUR God.’

21032.label: Ezekiel 20:21
21032.text: “‘“And the sons began to rebel against me. In my statutes they did not walk, and my judicial decisions they did not keep by doing them, which, should the man keep doing, he will also keep living by them. My sabbaths they profaned. So I promised to pour out my rage upon them, in order to bring my anger to its finish upon them in the wilderness.

21033.label: Ezekiel 20:22
21033.text: And I drew back my hand and went acting for the sake of my own name, that [it] should not be profaned before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.

21034.label: Ezekiel 20:23
21034.text: Also, I myself lifted up my hand [in an oath] to them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and to disperse them among the lands,

21035.label: Ezekiel 20:24
21035.text: for the reason that they did not carry out my own judicial decisions and they rejected my own statutes and they profaned my own sabbaths, and it was after the dungy idols of their forefathers that their eyes proved to be.

21036.label: Ezekiel 20:25
21036.text: And I myself also let them have regulations that were not good and judicial decisions by which they could not keep living.

21037.label: Ezekiel 20:26
21037.text: And I would let them become defiled by their gifts when [they] made every child opening the womb pass through [the fire], in order that I might make them desolate, in order that they might know that I am Jehovah.”’

21038.label: Ezekiel 20:27
21038.text: “Therefore speak to the house of Israel, O son of man, and you must say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Yet in this respect, YOUR forefathers spoke abusively of me, in their acting against me with unfaithfulness.

21039.label: Ezekiel 20:28
21039.text: And I proceeded to bring them into the land that I had lifted up my hand [in an oath] to give them. When they got to see every exalted hill and every branchy tree, then they began sacrificing there their sacrifices and giving there their offensive offering, and presenting there their restful odors and pouring out there their drink offerings.

21040.label: Ezekiel 20:29
21040.text: So I said to them, ‘What does the high place mean to which YOU are coming, that its name should be called a High Place down to this day?’”’

21041.label: Ezekiel 20:30
21041.text: “Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “In the way of YOUR forefathers are YOU people defiling yourselves, and after their disgusting things are YOU going in immoral intercourse?

21042.label: Ezekiel 20:31
21042.text: And in lifting up YOUR gifts by making YOUR sons pass through the fire, are YOU defiling yourselves for all YOUR dungy idols down till today? At the same time shall I myself be inquired of by YOU people, O house of Israel?”’ “‘As I am alive,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘I will not be inquired of by YOU.

21043.label: Ezekiel 20:32
21043.text: And that which is coming up into YOUR spirit will itself positively not happen, in that YOU are saying: “Let us become like the nations, like the families of the lands, in ministering to wood and stone.”’”

21044.label: Ezekiel 20:33
21044.text: “‘As I am alive,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘it will be with a strong hand and with a stretched-out arm and with outpoured rage that I will rule as king over YOU people.

21045.label: Ezekiel 20:34
21045.text: And I will bring YOU forth from the peoples, and I will collect YOU together out of the lands to which YOU have been scattered with a strong hand and with a stretched-out arm and with outpoured rage.

21046.label: Ezekiel 20:35
21046.text: And I will bring YOU into the wilderness of the peoples and put myself on judgment with YOU there face to face.

21047.label: Ezekiel 20:36
21047.text: “‘Just as I put myself on judgment with YOUR forefathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I shall put myself on judgment with YOU,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21048.label: Ezekiel 20:37
21048.text: ‘And I will make YOU pass under the rod and bring YOU into the bond of the covenant.

21049.label: Ezekiel 20:38
21049.text: And I will clean out from YOU the revolters and the transgressors against me, for out of the land of their alien residence I shall bring them forth, but onto the soil of Israel they will not come; and YOU people will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21050.label: Ezekiel 20:39
21050.text: “And YOU, O house of Israel, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Go serve each one of YOU his own dungy idols. And afterward if YOU are not listening to me, then my holy name YOU will no more profane by YOUR gifts and by YOUR dungy idols.’

21051.label: Ezekiel 20:40
21051.text: “‘For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘there is where they, the whole house of Israel in its entirety, will serve me, in the land. There I shall take pleasure in them, and there I shall require YOUR contributions and the firstfruits of YOUR presentations in all YOUR holy things.

21052.label: Ezekiel 20:41
21052.text: Because of the restful odor I shall take pleasure in YOU, when I bring YOU forth from the peoples and I actually collect YOU together from the lands to which YOU have been scattered, and I will be sanctified in YOU before the eyes of the nations.’

21053.label: Ezekiel 20:42
21053.text: “‘And YOU people will have to know that I am Jehovah, when I bring YOU onto the soil of Israel, into the land that I lifted up my hand [in an oath] to give to YOUR forefathers.

21054.label: Ezekiel 20:43
21054.text: And YOU will certainly remember there YOUR ways and all YOUR dealings by which YOU defiled yourselves, and YOU will actually feel a loathing at YOUR own faces because of all YOUR bad things that YOU did.

21055.label: Ezekiel 20:44
21055.text: And YOU will have to know that I am Jehovah when I take action with YOU for the sake of my name, not according to YOUR bad ways or according to YOUR corrupted dealings, O house of Israel,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21056.label: Ezekiel 20:45
21056.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21057.label: Ezekiel 20:46
21057.text: “Son of man, set your face in the direction of the southern quarter and drip [words] to the south, and prophesy to the forest of the field of [the] south.

21058.label: Ezekiel 20:47
21058.text: And you must say to the forest of the south, ‘Hear the word of Jehovah. This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Here I am setting a fire ablaze against you, and it must devour in you every still-moist tree and every dry tree. The kindling flame will not be extinguished, and by it all faces must be scorched from [the] south to the north.

21059.label: Ezekiel 20:48
21059.text: And all those of flesh must see that I myself, Jehovah, have set it afire, so that it will not be extinguished.”’”

21060.label: Ezekiel 20:49
21060.text: And I proceeded to say: “Alas, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah! They are saying respecting me, ‘Is he not composing proverbial sayings?’”

21061.label: Ezekiel 21:1
21061.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21062.label: Ezekiel 21:2
21062.text: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem and drip [words] toward the holy places, and prophesy against the soil of Israel.

21063.label: Ezekiel 21:3
21063.text: And you must say to the soil of Israel, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Here I am against you, and I will bring forth my sword out of its sheath and cut off from you righteous one and wicked one.

21064.label: Ezekiel 21:4
21064.text: In order that I may actually cut off from you righteous one and wicked one, therefore my sword will go forth from its sheath against all flesh from south to north.

21065.label: Ezekiel 21:5
21065.text: And all those of flesh will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have brought forth my sword from its sheath. No more will it go back.”’

21066.label: Ezekiel 21:6
21066.text: “And as for you, O son of man, sigh with shaking hips. Even with bitterness you should sigh before their eyes.

21067.label: Ezekiel 21:7
21067.text: And it must occur that, in case they say to you, ‘On account of what are you sighing?’ you must say, ‘At a report.’ For it will certainly come, and every heart must melt and all hands must drop down and every spirit must become dejected and all knees themselves will drip with water. ‘Look! It will certainly come and be brought to occur,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21068.label: Ezekiel 21:8
21068.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21069.label: Ezekiel 21:9
21069.text: “Son of man, prophesy, and you must say, ‘This is what Jehovah has said: “Say, ‘A sword, a sword! It has been sharpened, and it is also polished.

21070.label: Ezekiel 21:10
21070.text: For the purpose of organizing a slaughter it has been sharpened; for the purpose of its getting a glitter it has been polished.’”’” “Or shall we exult?” “‘Is it rejecting the scepter of my own son, as [it does] every tree?

21071.label: Ezekiel 21:11
21071.text: “‘And one gives it to be polished, in order to wield [it] with the hand. It—a sword has been sharpened, and it—it has been polished, in order to give it into the hand of a killer.

21072.label: Ezekiel 21:12
21072.text: “‘Cry out and howl, O son of man, for it itself has come to be against my people; it is against all the chieftains of Israel. The very ones hurled to the sword have come to be with my people. Therefore make a slap on [the] thigh.

21073.label: Ezekiel 21:13
21073.text: For an extermination has been made, and what [of it] if it is rejecting also the scepter? This will not continue existing,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21074.label: Ezekiel 21:14
21074.text: “And you, O son of man—prophesy, and strike palm against palm, and ‘A sword!’ should be repeated for three times. The sword of the slain ones it is. It is the sword of someone slain who is great, which is making an encirclement of them.

21075.label: Ezekiel 21:15
21075.text: In order for the heart to melt and [in order] to multiply those who are overthrown at all their gates, I will make a slaughter by the sword. Alas, it is made for a glittering, polished for a slaughter!

21076.label: Ezekiel 21:16
21076.text: Show yourself sharp; go to the right! Set your position; go to the left! To wherever your face is directed!

21077.label: Ezekiel 21:17
21077.text: And I myself also shall strike my one palm against my other palm, and I will bring my rage to its rest. I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.”

21078.label: Ezekiel 21:18
21078.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21079.label: Ezekiel 21:19
21079.text: “And as for you, O son of man, set for yourself two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to enter. From the one land both of them should go forth, and an [index] hand should be cut out; at the head of the way to the city it should be cut out.

21080.label: Ezekiel 21:20
21080.text: A way you should set for [the] sword to enter against Rabʹbah of the sons of Amʹmon, and [one] against Judah, against Jerusalem fortified.

21081.label: Ezekiel 21:21
21081.text: For the king of Babylon stood still at the crossways, at the head of the two ways, in order to resort to divination. He has shaken the arrows. He has asked by means of the teraphim; he has looked into the liver.

21082.label: Ezekiel 21:22
21082.text: In his right hand the divination proved to be for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open one’s mouth for a slaying, to raise the sound in an alarm signal, to set battering rams against gates, to throw up a siege rampart, to build a siege wall.

21083.label: Ezekiel 21:23
21083.text: And it has become to them like an untrue divination in their eyes —those who are sworn with oaths to them; and he is calling error to remembrance, in order [for them] to be caught.

21084.label: Ezekiel 21:24
21084.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘By reason of YOUR causing YOUR error to be remembered by YOUR transgressions being uncovered, in order that YOUR sins may be seen according to all YOUR dealings, by reason of YOUR being called to remembrance YOU people will be seized even by the hand.’

21085.label: Ezekiel 21:25
21085.text: “And as for you, O deadly wounded, wicked chieftain of Israel, whose day has come in the time of the error of [the] end,

21086.label: Ezekiel 21:26
21086.text: this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Remove the turban, and lift off the crown. This will not be the same. Put on high even what is low, and bring low even the high one.

21087.label: Ezekiel 21:27
21087.text: A ruin, a ruin, a ruin I shall make it. As for this also, it will certainly become no [one’s] until he comes who has the legal right, and I must give [it] to him.’

21088.label: Ezekiel 21:28
21088.text: “And you, O son of man, prophesy, and you must say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said concerning the sons of Amʹmon and concerning the reproach from them.’ And you must say, ‘A sword, a sword drawn for a slaughter, polished to cause [it] to devour, in order to glitter,

21089.label: Ezekiel 21:29
21089.text: because of [their] beholding for you an unreality, because of [their] divining for you a lie, in order to put you on the necks of the slain ones, the wicked men whose day has come in the time of the error of [the] end.

21090.label: Ezekiel 21:30
21090.text: Return [it] to its sheath. In the place that you were created, in the land of your origin, I shall judge you.

21091.label: Ezekiel 21:31
21091.text: And I will pour out upon you my denunciation. With the fire of my fury I shall blow upon you, and I will give you into the hand of men who are unreasoning, the craftsmen of ruination.

21092.label: Ezekiel 21:32
21092.text: For the fire you will become fuel. Your own blood will prove to be in the midst of the land. You will not be remembered, for I myself, Jehovah, have spoken.’”

21093.label: Ezekiel 22:1
21093.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21094.label: Ezekiel 22:2
21094.text: “And as for you, O son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloodguilty city and certainly cause her to know all her detestable things?

21095.label: Ezekiel 22:3
21095.text: And you must say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “O city that is shedding blood in her midst till her time comes, and that has made dungy idols within herself in order to become unclean,

21096.label: Ezekiel 22:4
21096.text: by your blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and by your dungy idols that you have made you have become unclean. And you bring your days near, and you will come to your years. That is why I must make you an object of reproach to the nations and of jeering to all the lands.

21097.label: Ezekiel 22:5
21097.text: The [lands] nearby and those far away from you will jeer you, O you unclean in name, abounding in confusion.

21098.label: Ezekiel 22:6
21098.text: Look! The chieftains of Israel have proved to be in you, each one [given over] to his arm for the purpose of shedding blood.

21099.label: Ezekiel 22:7
21099.text: Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you. Toward the alien resident they have acted with defrauding in the midst of you. Fatherless boy and widow they have maltreated in you.”’”

21100.label: Ezekiel 22:8
21100.text: “‘My holy places you have despised, and my sabbaths you have profaned.

21101.label: Ezekiel 22:9
21101.text: Outright slanderers have proved to be in you, for the purpose of shedding blood; and on the mountains they have eaten in you. Loose conduct they have carried on in the midst of you.

21102.label: Ezekiel 22:10
21102.text: The nakedness of a father they have uncovered in you; a woman unclean in [her] menstruation they have humiliated in you.

21103.label: Ezekiel 22:11
21103.text: And with the wife of his companion a man has done a detestable thing, and his own daughter-in-law a man has defiled with loose conduct; and his sister, the daughter of his own father, a man has humiliated in you.

21104.label: Ezekiel 22:12
21104.text: A bribe they have taken in you for the purpose of shedding blood. Interest and usury you have taken, and you violently keep making gain of your companions with defrauding, and me you have forgotten,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21105.label: Ezekiel 22:13
21105.text: “‘And, look! I have struck my hand at your unjust gain that you have made, and over your acts of bloodshed that have proved to be in the midst of you.

21106.label: Ezekiel 22:14
21106.text: Will your heart keep enduring or your hands furnish strength in the days when I am taking action toward you? I myself, Jehovah, have spoken and I will take action.

21107.label: Ezekiel 22:15
21107.text: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the lands, and I will destroy your uncleanness out of you.

21108.label: Ezekiel 22:16
21108.text: And you will certainly be profaned within yourself before the eyes of [the] nations, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’”

21109.label: Ezekiel 22:17
21109.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to come to me, saying:

21110.label: Ezekiel 22:18
21110.text: “Son of man, to me those of the house of Israel have become as scummy dross. All of them are copper and tin and iron and lead in the midst of a furnace. Much scummy dross, [that of] silver, they have become.

21111.label: Ezekiel 22:19
21111.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘For the reason that all of YOU have become as much scummy dross, therefore here I am collecting YOU together into the midst of Jerusalem.

21112.label: Ezekiel 22:20
21112.text: As in collecting silver and copper and iron and lead and tin into the midst of a furnace, in order to blow upon it with fire to cause a liquefying, so I shall collect [them] together in my anger and in my rage, and I will blow and cause YOU people to liquefy.

21113.label: Ezekiel 22:21
21113.text: And I will bring YOU together and blow upon YOU with the fire of my fury, and YOU must be liquefied in the midst of her.

21114.label: Ezekiel 22:22
21114.text: As in the liquefying of silver in the midst of a furnace, so YOU people will be liquefied in the midst of her; and YOU will have to know that I myself, Jehovah, have poured out my rage upon YOU.’”

21115.label: Ezekiel 22:23
21115.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to come to me, saying:

21116.label: Ezekiel 22:24
21116.text: “Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land not being cleansed, one not rained down upon in the day of denunciation.

21117.label: Ezekiel 22:25
21117.text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst of her, like the roaring lion, tearing prey. A soul they actually devour. Treasure and precious things they keep taking. Her widows they have multiplied in the midst of her.

21118.label: Ezekiel 22:26
21118.text: Her priests themselves have done violence to my law, and they keep profaning my holy places. Between the holy thing and the common they have made no distinction, and between the unclean thing and the clean they have made nothing known, and from my sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, and I am profaned in the midst of them.

21119.label: Ezekiel 22:27
21119.text: Her princes in the midst of her are like wolves tearing prey in shedding blood, in destroying souls for the purpose of making unjust gain.

21120.label: Ezekiel 22:28
21120.text: And her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, visioning an unreality and divining for them a lie, saying: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said,” when Jehovah himself has not spoken.

21121.label: Ezekiel 22:29
21121.text: The people of the land themselves have carried on a scheme of defrauding and have done a tearing away in robbery, and the afflicted one and the poor one they have maltreated, and the alien resident they have defrauded without justice.’

21122.label: Ezekiel 22:30
21122.text: “‘And I kept looking for a man from among them who would be repairing the stone wall and standing in the gap before me in behalf of the land, in order [for me] not to bring it to ruin; and I found no one.

21123.label: Ezekiel 22:31
21123.text: So I shall pour out my denunciation upon them. With the fire of my fury I will exterminate them. Their way I will bring upon their own head,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21124.label: Ezekiel 23:1
21124.text: And the word of Jehovah proceeded to come to me, saying:

21125.label: Ezekiel 23:2
21125.text: “Son of man, two women, the daughters of one mother, there happened to be.

21126.label: Ezekiel 23:3
21126.text: And they began to prostitute themselves in Egypt. In their youth they committed prostitution. There their breasts were squeezed, and there they pressed the bosoms of their virginity.

21127.label: Ezekiel 23:4
21127.text: And their names were O·hoʹlah the older one and O·holʹi·bah her sister, and they came to be mine and began to give birth to sons and daughters. And as for their names, O·hoʹlah is Sa·marʹi·a, and O·holʹi·bah is Jerusalem.

21128.label: Ezekiel 23:5
21128.text: “And O·hoʹlah began to prostitute herself, while subject to me, and kept lusting after those passionately loving her, after the As·syrʹi·ans, who were near,

21129.label: Ezekiel 23:6
21129.text: governors clothed with blue material, and deputy rulers—desirable young men all of them, cavalrymen riding horses.

21130.label: Ezekiel 23:7
21130.text: And she continued giving forth her prostitutions upon them, the choicest sons of As·syrʹi·a all of them; and with all those after whom she lusted—with their dungy idols—she defiled herself.

21131.label: Ezekiel 23:8
21131.text: And her prostitutions [carried] from Egypt she did not leave, for with her they had lain down in her youth, and they were the ones that pressed the bosoms of her virginity and they kept pouring out their immoral intercourse upon her.

21132.label: Ezekiel 23:9
21132.text: Therefore I gave her into the hand of those passionately loving her, into the hand of the sons of As·syrʹi·a, toward whom she had lusted.

21133.label: Ezekiel 23:10
21133.text: They were the ones that uncovered her nakedness. Her sons and her daughters they took, and her they killed even with sword. And she came to be infamy to women, and acts of judgment were what they executed upon her.

21134.label: Ezekiel 23:11
21134.text: “When her sister O·holʹi·bah got to see [it], then she exercised her sensual desire more ruinously than she, and her prostitution more than the fornication of her sister.

21135.label: Ezekiel 23:12
21135.text: For the sons of As·syrʹi·a she lusted, governors and deputy rulers who were near, clothed with perfect taste, cavalrymen riding horses—desirable young men all of them.

21136.label: Ezekiel 23:13
21136.text: And I got to see that, because she had defiled herself, both of them had one way.

21137.label: Ezekiel 23:14
21137.text: And she kept adding to her acts of prostitution when she got to see the men in carvings upon the wall, images of Chal·deʹans carved in vermilion,

21138.label: Ezekiel 23:15
21138.text: girded with belts on their hips, with pendant turbans on their heads, having the appearance of warriors, all of them, the likeness of the sons of Babylon, Chal·deʹans as respects the land of their birth.

21139.label: Ezekiel 23:16
21139.text: And she began to lust after them at the sight of her eyes and proceeded to send messengers to them in Chal·deʹa.

21140.label: Ezekiel 23:17
21140.text: And the sons of Babylon kept coming in to her, to the bed of expressions of love, and defiling her with their immoral intercourse; and she continued getting defiled by them, and her soul began to turn away disgusted from them.

21141.label: Ezekiel 23:18
21141.text: “And she went on uncovering her acts of prostitution and uncovering her nakedness, so that my soul turned away disgusted from company with her, just as my soul had turned away disgusted from company with her sister.

21142.label: Ezekiel 23:19
21142.text: And she kept multiplying her acts of prostitution to the point of calling to mind the days of her youth, when she prostituted herself in the land of Egypt.

21143.label: Ezekiel 23:20
21143.text: And she kept lusting in the style of concubines belonging to those whose fleshly member is as the fleshly member of male asses and whose genital organ is as the genital organ of male horses.

21144.label: Ezekiel 23:21
21144.text: And you continued calling attention to the loose conduct of your youth by the pressing of your bosoms from Egypt onward, for the sake of the breasts of your youth.

21145.label: Ezekiel 23:22
21145.text: “Therefore, O O·holʹi·bah, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am rousing up your passionate lovers against you, those from whom your soul has turned away in disgust, and I will bring them in against you on all sides,

21146.label: Ezekiel 23:23
21146.text: the sons of Babylon and all the Chal·deʹans, Peʹkod and Shoʹa and Koʹa, all the sons of As·syrʹi·a with them, desirable young men, governors and deputy rulers all of them, warriors and summoned ones, riding on horses, all of them.

21147.label: Ezekiel 23:24
21147.text: And they must come in against you with rattling of war chariots and wheels, and with a congregation of peoples, with large shield and buckler and helmet. They will set themselves against you all around, and I will give judgment over to them, and they must judge you with their judgments.

21148.label: Ezekiel 23:25
21148.text: And I will express my ardor against you, and they must take action against you in rage. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and the remainder of you will fall even by the sword. Your sons and your daughters they themselves will take, and the remainder of you will be devoured by the fire.

21149.label: Ezekiel 23:26
21149.text: And they will certainly strip off you your garments and take away your beautiful articles.

21150.label: Ezekiel 23:27
21150.text: And I shall actually cause your loose conduct to cease from you, and your prostitution [carried] from the land of Egypt; and you will not raise your eyes to them, and Egypt you will remember no more.’

21151.label: Ezekiel 23:28
21151.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am giving you into the hand of those whom you have hated, into the hand of those from whom your soul has turned away disgusted.

21152.label: Ezekiel 23:29
21152.text: And they must take action against you in hatred and take away all your product of toil and leave you naked and nude; and the nudeness of your acts of fornication and your loose conduct and your acts of prostitution must be uncovered.

21153.label: Ezekiel 23:30
21153.text: There will be a doing of these things to you because of your going like a prostitute after [the] nations, on account of the fact that you defiled yourself with their dungy idols.

21154.label: Ezekiel 23:31
21154.text: In the way of your sister you have walked; and I shall have to give her cup into your hand.’

21155.label: Ezekiel 23:32
21155.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘The cup of your sister you will drink, the deep and wide one. You will become an object of laughter and derision, [the cup] containing much.

21156.label: Ezekiel 23:33
21156.text: With drunkenness and grief you will be filled, with the cup of astonishment and of desolation, the cup of your sister Sa·marʹi·a.

21157.label: Ezekiel 23:34
21157.text: And you will have to drink it and drain [it] out, and its earthenware fragments you will gnaw, and your breasts you will tear out. “For I myself have spoken,” is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’

21158.label: Ezekiel 23:35
21158.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘For the reason that you have forgotten me and you proceeded to cast me behind your back, then you yourself also bear your loose conduct and your acts of prostitution.’”

21159.label: Ezekiel 23:36
21159.text: And Jehovah went on to say to me: “Son of man, will you judge O·hoʹlah and O·holʹi·bah and tell them their detestable things?

21160.label: Ezekiel 23:37
21160.text: For they have committed adultery and there is blood on their hands, and with their dungy idols they have committed adultery. And, besides that, their sons whom they had borne to me they made pass through [the fire] to them as food.

21161.label: Ezekiel 23:38
21161.text: What is more, this is what they have done to me: They have defiled my sanctuary in that day, and my sabbaths they have profaned.

21162.label: Ezekiel 23:39
21162.text: And when they had slaughtered their sons to their dungy idols they even proceeded to come into my sanctuary on that day to profane it, and, look! that is what they have done in the midst of my house.

21163.label: Ezekiel 23:40
21163.text: And in addition to that, when they began to send to the men coming from far away, to whom there was sent a messenger, then, look! they came, for whom you had washed yourself, painted your eyes and decked yourself with ornaments.

21164.label: Ezekiel 23:41
21164.text: And you sat down upon a glorious couch, with a table set in order before it, and my incense and my oil you put upon it.

21165.label: Ezekiel 23:42
21165.text: And the sound of a crowd at ease was in her, and to the men out of the mass of mankind there were drunkards being brought in from the wilderness, and they proceeded to put bracelets on the hands of the women and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

21166.label: Ezekiel 23:43
21166.text: “Then I said respecting her who was worn out with adultery, ‘Now she will keep on committing her prostitution, even she herself.’

21167.label: Ezekiel 23:44
21167.text: And they kept on coming in to her, just as one comes in to a woman that is a prostitute; in that manner they came in to O·hoʹlah and to O·holʹi·bah as women of loose conduct.

21168.label: Ezekiel 23:45
21168.text: But as regards righteous men, they are the ones that will judge her with the judgment for adulteresses and with the judgment for female shedders of blood; for adulteresses are what they are, and there is blood on their hands.

21169.label: Ezekiel 23:46
21169.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘There will be the bringing up of a congregation against them and a making of them a frightful object and something to plunder.

21170.label: Ezekiel 23:47
21170.text: And the congregation must pelt them with stones, and there will be a cutting of them down with their swords. Their sons and their daughters they will kill, and with fire their houses they will burn.

21171.label: Ezekiel 23:48
21171.text: And I shall certainly cause loose conduct to cease out of the land, and all the women will have to let themselves be corrected, so that they will not do according to YOUR loose conduct.

21172.label: Ezekiel 23:49
21172.text: And they must bring YOUR loose conduct upon YOU, and the sins of YOUR dungy idols YOU will bear; and YOU people will have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’”

21173.label: Ezekiel 24:1
21173.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth [day] of the month, saying:

21174.label: Ezekiel 24:2
21174.text: “Son of man, write down for yourself the name of the day, this selfsame day. The king of Babylon has thrown himself against Jerusalem on this selfsame day.

21175.label: Ezekiel 24:3
21175.text: And compose a proverbial saying concerning the rebellious house, and you must say concerning them, “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Put the widemouthed cooking pot on; put [it] on, and also pour water into it.

21176.label: Ezekiel 24:4
21176.text: Gather pieces in it, every good piece, thigh and shoulder; fill [it] even with the choicest bones.

21177.label: Ezekiel 24:5
21177.text: Let there be a taking of the choicest sheep, and also stack the logs in a circle under it. Boil its pieces, also cook its bones in the midst of it.”’”

21178.label: Ezekiel 24:6
21178.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Woe to the city of deeds of bloodshed, the widemouthed cooking pot, the rust of which is in it, and the very rust of which has not gone forth from it! Piece by piece of it, bring it out; no lot must be cast over it.

21179.label: Ezekiel 24:7
21179.text: For its very blood has come to be right in the midst of it. Upon the shining, bare surface of a crag she placed it. She did not pour it out upon the earth, in order to cover it over with dust.

21180.label: Ezekiel 24:8
21180.text: In order to bring up rage for the executing of vengeance, I have put her blood upon the shining, bare surface of a crag, in order that it may not be covered over.’

21181.label: Ezekiel 24:9
21181.text: “Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Woe to the city of deeds of bloodshed! I myself also shall make the pile great.

21182.label: Ezekiel 24:10
21182.text: Make the logs many. Kindle the fire. Boil the flesh thoroughly. And empty out the broth, and let the bones themselves become piping hot.

21183.label: Ezekiel 24:11
21183.text: Stand it empty upon its coals in order that it may get hot; and its copper must become heated up, and its uncleanness must be liquefied in the midst of it. Let its rust get consumed.

21184.label: Ezekiel 24:12
21184.text: Troubles! It has made [one] tired, but the great amount of its rust does not go forth from it. Into [the] fire with its rust!’

21185.label: Ezekiel 24:13
21185.text: “‘There was loose conduct in your uncleanness. For that reason I had to cleanse you, but you did not become clean from your uncleanness. You will become clean no more until I cause my rage to come to its rest in your case.

21186.label: Ezekiel 24:14
21186.text: I myself, Jehovah, have spoken. It must come, and I will act. I shall not neglect, neither shall I feel sorry nor feel regret. According to your ways and according to your dealings they will certainly judge you,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21187.label: Ezekiel 24:15
21187.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21188.label: Ezekiel 24:16
21188.text: “Son of man, here I am taking away from you the thing desirable to your eyes by a blow, and you should not beat your breast, neither should you weep nor should your tears come on.

21189.label: Ezekiel 24:17
21189.text: Sigh without words. For the dead ones no mourning should you make. Your headdress bind on yourself, and your sandals you should put upon your feet. And you should not cover over [the] mustache, and the bread of men you should not eat.”

21190.label: Ezekiel 24:18
21190.text: And I proceeded to speak to the people in the morning, and my wife gradually died in the evening. So I did in the morning just as I had been commanded.

21191.label: Ezekiel 24:19
21191.text: And the people kept saying to me: “Will you not tell us what these things have to do with us, that you are doing?”

21192.label: Ezekiel 24:20
21192.text: Then I said to them: “The very word of Jehovah has occurred to me, saying,

21193.label: Ezekiel 24:21
21193.text: ‘Say to the house of Israel: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am profaning my sanctuary, the pride of YOUR strength, the thing desirable to YOUR eyes and the object of YOUR soul’s compassion, and YOUR sons and YOUR daughters whom YOU people have left behind—by the sword they will fall.

21194.label: Ezekiel 24:22
21194.text: And YOU will have to do just as I have done. Mustaches YOU will not cover over, and the bread of men YOU will not eat.

21195.label: Ezekiel 24:23
21195.text: And YOUR headdress will be on YOUR heads, and YOUR sandals be upon YOUR feet. YOU will not beat yourselves nor will YOU weep, and YOU will have to rot away in YOUR errors, and YOU will actually groan over one another.

21196.label: Ezekiel 24:24
21196.text: And Ezekiel has become for YOU a portent. In accord with all that he has done, YOU will do. When it comes, YOU will also have to know that I am the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.’”’”

21197.label: Ezekiel 24:25
21197.text: “And as for you, O son of man, will it not be in the day of my taking away from them their fortress, the beautiful object of their exultation, the thing desirable to their eyes and the longing of their soul, their sons and their daughters, that

21198.label: Ezekiel 24:26
21198.text: in that day there will come to you the escaped one for making the ears hear?

21199.label: Ezekiel 24:27
21199.text: In that day your mouth will be opened to the escaped one, and you will speak and be mute no longer; and you will certainly become to them a portent, and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.”

21200.label: Ezekiel 25:1
21200.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21201.label: Ezekiel 25:2
21201.text: “Son of man, set your face toward the sons of Amʹmon and prophesy against them.

21202.label: Ezekiel 25:3
21202.text: And you must say concerning the sons of Amʹmon, ‘Hear the word of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah. This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “For the reason that you have said Aha! against my sanctuary, because it has been profaned, and against the soil of Israel, because it has been laid desolate, and against the house of Judah, because they have gone into exile,

21203.label: Ezekiel 25:4
21203.text: therefore here I am giving you to the Orientals as something to possess, and they will set up their walled camps in you and will certainly put in you their tabernacles. They themselves will eat your fruitage, and they themselves will drink your milk.

21204.label: Ezekiel 25:5
21204.text: And I will make Rabʹbah a pasture ground of camels and the sons of Amʹmon a resting-place of a flock; and YOU people will have to know that I am Jehovah.”’”

21205.label: Ezekiel 25:6
21205.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘For the reason that you clapped the hands and you stamped with the feet and you kept rejoicing with all scorn on your part in [your] soul against the soil of Israel,

21206.label: Ezekiel 25:7
21206.text: therefore here I am; I have stretched out my hand against you, and I will give you as something to plunder to the nations; and I will cut you off from the peoples and destroy you from the lands. I shall annihilate you, and you will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21207.label: Ezekiel 25:8
21207.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘For the reason that Moʹab and Seʹir have said: “Look! The house of Judah is like all the other nations,”

21208.label: Ezekiel 25:9
21208.text: therefore here I am opening the slope of Moʹab at the cities, at his cities to his frontier, the decoration of [the] land, Beth-jeshʹi·moth, Baʹal-meʹon, even to Kir·i·a·thaʹim,

21209.label: Ezekiel 25:10
21209.text: to the Orientals, alongside the sons of Amʹmon; and I will make it something to possess, in order that it may not be remembered, [that is,] the sons of Amʹmon, among the nations.

21210.label: Ezekiel 25:11
21210.text: And in Moʹab I shall execute acts of judgment; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21211.label: Ezekiel 25:12
21211.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘For the reason that Eʹdom has acted in taking vengeance upon the house of Judah and they kept doing wrong extensively and avenged themselves on them,

21212.label: Ezekiel 25:13
21212.text: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “I will also stretch out my hand against Eʹdom and cut off from it man and domestic animal, and I will make it a devastated place from Teʹman, even to Deʹdan. By the sword they will fall.

21213.label: Ezekiel 25:14
21213.text: ‘And I will bring my vengeance on Eʹdom by the hand of my people Israel; and they must do in Eʹdom according to my anger and according to my rage; and they will have to know what my vengeance is,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”’

21214.label: Ezekiel 25:15
21214.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘For the reason that the Phi·lisʹtines have acted with vengeance and they kept avenging themselves with a vengeance with scorn in [the] soul, in order to cause ruin, with an indefinitely lasting enmity,

21215.label: Ezekiel 25:16
21215.text: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “Here I am stretching out my hand against the Phi·lisʹtines, and I will cut off the Cherʹe·thites and destroy the rest of the seacoast.

21216.label: Ezekiel 25:17
21216.text: And I will execute in them great acts of vengeance, with raging reproofs; and they will have to know that I am Jehovah when I bring my vengeance on them.”’”

21217.label: Ezekiel 26:1
21217.text: And it came about in the eleventh year, on the first [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah occurred to me, saying:

21218.label: Ezekiel 26:2
21218.text: “Son of man, for the reason that Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She has been broken, the doors of the peoples! The trend will certainly be to me. I shall be filled—she has been devastated,’

21219.label: Ezekiel 26:3
21219.text: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am against you, O Tyre, and I will bring up against you many nations, just as the sea brings up its waves.

21220.label: Ezekiel 26:4
21220.text: And they will certainly bring the walls of Tyre to ruin and tear down her towers, and I will scrape her dust away from her and make her a shining, bare surface of a crag.

21221.label: Ezekiel 26:5
21221.text: A drying yard for dragnets is what she will become in the midst of the sea.’ “‘For I myself have spoken,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘and she must become an object of plunder for the nations.

21222.label: Ezekiel 26:6
21222.text: And her dependent towns that are in the field—by the sword they will be killed, and people will have to know that I am Jehovah.’

21223.label: Ezekiel 26:7
21223.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘Here I am bringing against Tyre Neb·u·chad·rezʹzar the king of Babylon from the north, a king of kings, with horses and war chariots and cavalrymen and a congregation, even a multitudinous people.

21224.label: Ezekiel 26:8
21224.text: Your dependent towns in the field he will kill even with the sword, and he must make against you a siege wall and throw up against you a siege rampart and raise up against you a large shield;

21225.label: Ezekiel 26:9
21225.text: and the strike of his attack engine he will direct against your walls, and your towers he will pull down, with his swords.

21226.label: Ezekiel 26:10
21226.text: Owing to the heaving mass of his horses their dust will cover you. Owing to the sound of cavalryman and wheel and war chariot your walls will rock, when he comes in through your gates, as in the cases of entering into a city opened by breaches.

21227.label: Ezekiel 26:11
21227.text: With the hoofs of his horses he will trample down all your streets. Your people he will kill even with the sword, and to the earth your own pillars of strength will go down.

21228.label: Ezekiel 26:12
21228.text: And they will certainly spoil your resources and plunder your sales goods, and tear down your walls, and your desirable houses they will pull down. And your stones and your woodwork and your dust they will place in the very midst of the water.’

21229.label: Ezekiel 26:13
21229.text: “‘And I will cause the turmoil of your singing to cease, and the very sound of your harps will be heard no more.

21230.label: Ezekiel 26:14
21230.text: And I will make you a shining, bare surface of a crag. A drying yard for dragnets is what you will become. Never will you be rebuilt; for I myself, Jehovah, have spoken,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21231.label: Ezekiel 26:15
21231.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said to Tyre, ‘At the sound of your downfall, when the fatally wounded one groans, when there is a killing with slaughter in the midst of you, will not the islands rock?

21232.label: Ezekiel 26:16
21232.text: And down from their thrones all the chieftains of the sea will certainly come and remove their sleeveless coats, and they will strip off their own embroidered garments. They will put on trembling spells. Upon the earth they will sit down, and they will certainly tremble every moment and stare in amazement at you.

21233.label: Ezekiel 26:17
21233.text: And they must raise up over you a dirge and say to you: “‘“How you have perished, that used to be inhabited from the seas, O praised city, who became a strong one in the sea, she and those inhabiting her, those who gave their terror to all the inhabitants [of the earth]!

21234.label: Ezekiel 26:18
21234.text: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your downfall. And the islands that are in the sea must be disturbed owing to your going out.”’

21235.label: Ezekiel 26:19
21235.text: “For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘When I make you a devastated city, like the cities that are actually not inhabited, when [I] bring up over you the watery deep, and the vast waters will have covered you,

21236.label: Ezekiel 26:20
21236.text: I will also bring you down with those going down into the pit to the people of long ago, and I will cause you to dwell in the lowest land, like places devastated for a long time, with those going down into the pit, in order that you may not be inhabited; and I will put decoration in the land of those alive.

21237.label: Ezekiel 26:21
21237.text: “‘Sudden terrors are what I shall make you, and you will not be; and you will be sought for, but you will no more be found to time indefinite,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21238.label: Ezekiel 27:1
21238.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21239.label: Ezekiel 27:2
21239.text: “And as for you, O son of man, raise up concerning Tyre a dirge,

21240.label: Ezekiel 27:3
21240.text: and you must say to Tyre, “‘O you who are dwelling at the entrances of [the] sea, the tradeswoman of the peoples for many islands, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “O Tyre, you yourself have said, ‘I am perfect in prettiness.’

21241.label: Ezekiel 27:4
21241.text: In the heart of [the] seas are your territories. Your own builders have perfected your prettiness.

21242.label: Ezekiel 27:5
21242.text: Out of juniper timbers from Seʹnir they built for you all the planks. A cedar from Lebʹa·non they took to make a mast upon you.

21243.label: Ezekiel 27:6
21243.text: Out of massive trees from Baʹshan they made your oars. Your prow they made with ivory in cypress wood, from the islands of Kitʹtim.

21244.label: Ezekiel 27:7
21244.text: Linen in various colors from Egypt your cloth expanse happened to be, in order for [it] to serve as your sail. Blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple from the islands of E·liʹshah are what your deck covering proved to be.

21245.label: Ezekiel 27:8
21245.text: “‘“The inhabitants of Siʹdon and of Arʹvad themselves became rowers for you. Your skilled ones, O Tyre, happened to be in you; they were your sailors.

21246.label: Ezekiel 27:9
21246.text: Even old men of Geʹbal and her skilled ones happened to be in you as caulkers for your seams. All the ships of the sea and their mariners themselves proved to be in you, in order to exchange articles of merchandise.

21247.label: Ezekiel 27:10
21247.text: Persians and Luʹdim and men of Put —they happened to be in your military force, your men of war. Shield and helmet they hung up in you. They were the ones that caused your splendor.

21248.label: Ezekiel 27:11
21248.text: The sons of Arʹvad, even your military force, were upon your walls all around, and valorous men were the ones that happened to be in your own towers. Their circular shields they hung up on your walls all around. They themselves perfected your prettiness.

21249.label: Ezekiel 27:12
21249.text: “‘“Tarʹshish was your merchant because of the abundance of all sorts of valuable things. For [its] silver, iron, tin and lead, your stores were given.

21250.label: Ezekiel 27:13
21250.text: Jaʹvan, Tuʹbal and Meʹshech themselves were your traders. For the souls of mankind and articles of copper your articles of exchange were given.

21251.label: Ezekiel 27:14
21251.text: From the house of To·garʹmah there were horses and steeds and mules, [for which] your stores were given.

21252.label: Ezekiel 27:15
21252.text: The sons of Deʹdan were your traders; many islands were merchants in your employ; horns of ivory and ebony they have paid back as gift to you.

21253.label: Ezekiel 27:16
21253.text: Eʹdom was your merchant because of the abundance of your works. For turquoise, wool dyed reddish purple and material of various colors and fine fabric and corals and rubies, your stores were given in exchange.

21254.label: Ezekiel 27:17
21254.text: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel themselves were your traders. For the wheat of Minʹnith and special foodstuff and honey and oil and balsam, your articles of exchange were given.

21255.label: Ezekiel 27:18
21255.text: “‘“Damascus was your merchant in the abundance of your works, because of the abundance of all your valuable things, with the wine of Helʹbon and the wool of reddish gray.

21256.label: Ezekiel 27:19
21256.text: Veʹdan and Jaʹvan from Uʹzal—for your stores they gave. Iron in wrought works, cassia and cane —for your articles of exchange they proved to be.

21257.label: Ezekiel 27:20
21257.text: Deʹdan was your trader in garments of woven material for riding.

21258.label: Ezekiel 27:21
21258.text: The Arabs and all the chieftains of Keʹdar themselves were merchants in your employ. In male lambs and rams and he-goats —in them they were your merchants.

21259.label: Ezekiel 27:22
21259.text: The traders of Sheʹba and Raʹa·mah themselves were your traders; for the finest of all sorts of perfumes and for all sorts of precious stones and gold, your stores were given.

21260.label: Ezekiel 27:23
21260.text: Haʹran and Canʹneh and Eʹden, the traders of Sheʹba, Asʹshur [and] Chilʹmad were your traders.

21261.label: Ezekiel 27:24
21261.text: They were your traders in gorgeous garments, in wraps of blue material and material of various colors and in carpets of two-colored stuff, in ropes twined and solidly made, in your trading center.

21262.label: Ezekiel 27:25
21262.text: “‘“The ships of Tarʹshish were your caravans for your articles of exchange, so that you get filled and become very glorious in the heart of the open sea.

21263.label: Ezekiel 27:26
21263.text: “‘“Into vast waters those rowing you have brought you. The east wind itself has broken you in the heart of the open sea.

21264.label: Ezekiel 27:27
21264.text: Your valuable things and your stores, your articles of exchange, your mariners and your sailors, the caulkers of your seams and those exchanging your articles of merchandise and all your men of war, who are in you and in all your congregation, who are in the midst of you,—they will fall in the heart of the open sea in the day of your downfall.

21265.label: Ezekiel 27:28
21265.text: “‘“At the sound of the outcry of your sailors the open country will rock.

21266.label: Ezekiel 27:29
21266.text: And all those handling an oar, mariners, all the sailors of the sea, will certainly go down from their ships; upon the land they will stand.

21267.label: Ezekiel 27:30
21267.text: And over you they will certainly let themselves be heard with their voice and will cry out bitterly. And they will bring up dust upon their heads. In the ashes they will wallow.

21268.label: Ezekiel 27:31
21268.text: And they will have to make [themselves] bald with a baldness for you, and gird on sackcloth and weep over you in bitterness of soul, with bitter wailing.

21269.label: Ezekiel 27:32
21269.text: And for you in their lamentation they will certainly lift up a dirge and chant over you, “‘“‘Who is like Tyre, like her that has been brought to silence in the midst of the sea?

21270.label: Ezekiel 27:33
21270.text: When your stores went forth from the open sea, you satisfied many peoples. With the abundance of your valuable things and your articles of exchange you made earth’s kings rich.

21271.label: Ezekiel 27:34
21271.text: Now you have been broken by the open sea, in the depths of the waters. As for your articles of exchange and all your congregation, in the midst of you they have fallen.

21272.label: Ezekiel 27:35
21272.text: All the inhabitants of the islands —in amazement they will certainly stare at you, and their kings themselves will have to shudder in horror. Faces must become perturbed.

21273.label: Ezekiel 27:36
21273.text: As for merchants among the peoples, they will certainly whistle over you. Sudden terrors are what you must become, and you will be no more to time indefinite.’”’”

21274.label: Ezekiel 28:1
21274.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21275.label: Ezekiel 28:2
21275.text: “Son of man, say to the leader of Tyre, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “‘“For the reason that your heart has become haughty, and you keep saying, ‘I am a god. In the seat of god I have seated myself, in the heart of the open sea,’ whereas an earthling man is what you are, and not a god, and you keep making your heart like the heart of god—

21276.label: Ezekiel 28:3
21276.text: look! you are wiser than Daniel. There are no secrets that have proved a match for you.

21277.label: Ezekiel 28:4
21277.text: By your wisdom and by your discernment you have made wealth for your own self, and you keep getting gold and silver in your storehouses.

21278.label: Ezekiel 28:5
21278.text: By the abundance of your wisdom, by your sales goods, you have made your wealth abound, and your heart began to be haughty because of your wealth.”’

21279.label: Ezekiel 28:6
21279.text: “‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “For the reason that you make your heart like the heart of god,

21280.label: Ezekiel 28:7
21280.text: therefore here I am bringing upon you strangers, the tyrants of [the] nations, and they will certainly draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and profane your beaming splendor.

21281.label: Ezekiel 28:8
21281.text: Down to the pit they will bring you, and you must die the death of someone slain in the heart of the open sea.

21282.label: Ezekiel 28:9
21282.text: Will you without fail say, ‘I am god,’ before the one killing you, whereas you are a mere earthling man, and not a god, in the hand of those profaning you?”’

21283.label: Ezekiel 28:10
21283.text: “‘The deaths of uncircumcised ones you will die by the hand of strangers, for I myself have spoken,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21284.label: Ezekiel 28:11
21284.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21285.label: Ezekiel 28:12
21285.text: “Son of man, lift up a dirge concerning the king of Tyre, and you must say to him, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “‘“You are sealing up a pattern, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

21286.label: Ezekiel 28:13
21286.text: In Eʹden, the garden of God, you proved to be. Every precious stone was your covering, ruby, topaz and jasper; chrysʹo·lite, onyx and jade; sapphire, turquoise and emerald; and of gold was the workmanship of your settings and your sockets in you. In the day of your being created they were made ready.

21287.label: Ezekiel 28:14
21287.text: You are the anointed cherub that is covering, and I have set you. On the holy mountain of God you proved to be. In the midst of fiery stones you walked about.

21288.label: Ezekiel 28:15
21288.text: You were faultless in your ways from the day of your being created until unrighteousness was found in you.

21289.label: Ezekiel 28:16
21289.text: “‘“Because of the abundance of your sales goods they filled the midst of you with violence, and you began to sin. And I shall put you as profane out of the mountain of God, and I shall destroy you, O cherub that is covering, from the midst of the fiery stones.

21290.label: Ezekiel 28:17
21290.text: “‘“Your heart became haughty because of your beauty. You brought your wisdom to ruin on account of your beaming splendor. Onto the earth I will throw you. Before kings I will set you, [for them] to look upon you.

21291.label: Ezekiel 28:18
21291.text: “‘“Owing to the abundance of your errors, because of the injustice of your sales goods, you have profaned your sanctuaries. And I shall bring forth a fire from the midst of you. It is what must devour you. And I shall make you ashes upon the earth before the eyes of all those seeing you.

21292.label: Ezekiel 28:19
21292.text: As for all those knowing you among the peoples, they will certainly stare in amazement at you. Sudden terrors are what you must become, and you will be no more to time indefinite.”’”

21293.label: Ezekiel 28:20
21293.text: And the word of Jehovah continued to occur to me, saying:

21294.label: Ezekiel 28:21
21294.text: “Son of man, set your face toward Siʹdon, and prophesy against her.

21295.label: Ezekiel 28:22
