21637.text: And on the outside of the inner gate there were the dining rooms of the singers, in the inner courtyard, which is on the side of the north gate. And their front side was toward the south. There was one on the side of the east gate. The front was toward the north.

21638.label: Ezekiel 40:45
21638.text: And he proceeded to speak to me: “This one, the dining room the front of which is toward the south, is for the priests who are taking care of the obligation of the house.

21639.label: Ezekiel 40:46
21639.text: And the dining room the front of which is toward the north is for the priests who are taking care of the obligation of the altar. They are the sons of Zaʹdok, who, from the sons of Leʹvi, are approaching Jehovah to minister to him.”

21640.label: Ezekiel 40:47
21640.text: And he went measuring the [inner] courtyard. The length was a hundred cubits, and the width a hundred cubits, foursquare. And the altar was before the house.

21641.label: Ezekiel 40:48
21641.text: And he proceeded to bring me into the porch of the house, and he went measuring the side pillar of the porch, five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side. And the width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

21642.label: Ezekiel 40:49
21642.text: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the width eleven cubits. And by steps was how they would go up to it. And there were pillars by the side posts, one over here and one over there.

21643.label: Ezekiel 41:1
21643.text: And he proceeded to bring me into the temple, and he went measuring the side pillars, six cubits being the width over here and six cubits the width over there, the width of the side pillar.

21644.label: Ezekiel 41:2
21644.text: And the width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits over here and five cubits over there. And he went measuring its length, forty cubits; and the width, twenty cubits.

21645.label: Ezekiel 41:3
21645.text: And he went inside and proceeded to measure the side pillar of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance was seven cubits.

21646.label: Ezekiel 41:4
21646.text: And he went measuring its length, twenty cubits; and [its] width, twenty cubits, before the temple. Then he said to me: “This is the Most Holy.”

21647.label: Ezekiel 41:5
21647.text: And he proceeded to measure the wall of the house, six cubits. And the width of the side chamber was four cubits, round about; all around the house it was, round about.

21648.label: Ezekiel 41:6
21648.text: And the side chambers were side chamber upon side chamber, three [stories], and for thirty times; and they were entering into the wall that belonged to the house, that is, the side chambers all around, in order that they might be held in, but they were not held in in the wall of the house.

21649.label: Ezekiel 41:7
21649.text: And there was a widening out and turning around upward and upward to the side chambers, for the winding passage of the house was upward and upward all around the house. Therefore there was a widening to the house upward, and from the lowest [story] one could go up to the uppermost [story], by the middle [story].

21650.label: Ezekiel 41:8
21650.text: And I saw that there was a high platform for the house all around. As regards the foundations of the side chambers, there was a full reed of six cubits to the joining.

21651.label: Ezekiel 41:9
21651.text: The width of the wall that belonged to the side chamber, to the outside, was five cubits. And there was a space left open [by] the construction of the side chambers that belonged to the house.

21652.label: Ezekiel 41:10
21652.text: And between the dining rooms the width was twenty cubits round about the house, all around.

21653.label: Ezekiel 41:11
21653.text: And the entrance of the side chamber was to the space left open, one entrance being toward the north and one entrance to the south; and the width of the area of the space left open was five cubits, all around.

21654.label: Ezekiel 41:12
21654.text: And the building that was before the separated area, the side [of which] was toward the west, was seventy cubits wide. And the wall of the building was five cubits in width, it being all around; and its length was ninety cubits.

21655.label: Ezekiel 41:13
21655.text: And he measured the house, a hundred cubits in length; and the separated area and the building and its walls, a hundred cubits in length.

21656.label: Ezekiel 41:14
21656.text: And the width of the front of the house and the separated area to the east was a hundred cubits.

21657.label: Ezekiel 41:15
21657.text: And he measured the length of the building before the separated area that was behind it and its galleries on this side and on that side, a hundred cubits. Also the temple [and] the inner place and the porches of the courtyard;

21658.label: Ezekiel 41:16
21658.text: the thresholds, and the windows with narrowing frames, and the galleries were round about the three of them. In front of the threshold there was paneling of wood all around, and [from] the floor up to the windows; and the windows were covered ones.

21659.label: Ezekiel 41:17
21659.text: To above the entrance and as far as the inner house and on the outside and upon the whole wall all around, on the inner [house] and on the outside, there were measurements,

21660.label: Ezekiel 41:18
21660.text: even carved cherubs and palm-tree figures, with a palm-tree figure between a cherub and a cherub, and the cherub had two faces.

21661.label: Ezekiel 41:19
21661.text: And the face of a man was toward the palm-tree figure on this side, and the face of a maned young lion was toward the palm-tree figure on that side, they being carved on the whole house all around.

21662.label: Ezekiel 41:20
21662.text: From the floor to above the entrance there were carved cherubs and palm-tree figures, [on] the wall of the temple.

21663.label: Ezekiel 41:21
21663.text: As for the temple, the doorpost was squared; and [in] front of the holy place there was an appearance like the [following] appearance:

21664.label: Ezekiel 41:22
21664.text: the wooden altar was three cubits high, and its length was two cubits, and it had its corner posts. And its length and its walls were of wood. And he proceeded to speak to me: “This is the table that is before Jehovah.”

21665.label: Ezekiel 41:23
21665.text: And the temple and the holy place had two doors.

21666.label: Ezekiel 41:24
21666.text: And two door leaves belonged to the doors, the two being turnable. One door had two door leaves, and the other had two door leaves.

21667.label: Ezekiel 41:25
21667.text: And there were made upon them, upon the doors of the temple, cherubs and palm-tree figures, like those made for the walls, and there was a canopy of wood over the front of the porch outside.

21668.label: Ezekiel 41:26
21668.text: And there were windows of narrowing frames and palm-tree figures over here and over there along the sides of the porch and the side chambers of the house and the canopies.

21669.label: Ezekiel 42:1
21669.text: And he gradually brought me forth to the outer courtyard by the way toward the north. And he proceeded to bring me to the dining-room [block] that was in front of the separated area and that was in front of the building to the north.

21670.label: Ezekiel 42:2
21670.text: Before the length of a hundred cubits there was the north entrance, and the width was fifty cubits.

21671.label: Ezekiel 42:3
21671.text: In front of the twenty [cubits] that belonged to the inner courtyard and in front of the pavement that belonged to the outer courtyard there was gallery opposite gallery in three [stories].

21672.label: Ezekiel 42:4
21672.text: And before the dining rooms there was a walkway ten cubits in width to the inside, a way of one cubit, and their entrances were to the north.

21673.label: Ezekiel 42:5
21673.text: And as for the dining rooms, the uppermost ones were shorter, for the galleries took away from them, more than the lowest ones and than the middle ones, as regards [the] building.

21674.label: Ezekiel 42:6
21674.text: For they were in three stories, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the courtyards. That is why more room was taken away than from the lowest ones and from the middle ones from the floor.

21675.label: Ezekiel 42:7
21675.text: And the stone wall that was outside was close by the dining rooms toward the outer courtyard before the [other] dining rooms. Its length was fifty cubits.

21676.label: Ezekiel 42:8
21676.text: For the length of the dining rooms that were toward the outer courtyard was fifty cubits, and, look! before the temple it was a hundred cubits.

21677.label: Ezekiel 42:9
21677.text: And from below these dining rooms the entryway was to the east, when one comes in to them from the outer courtyard.

21678.label: Ezekiel 42:10
21678.text: In the width of the stone wall of the courtyard toward the east, before the separated area and before the building, there were dining rooms.

21679.label: Ezekiel 42:11
21679.text: And there was a way before them like the appearance of the dining rooms that were toward the north, so their length was [and] so their width was; and all their exits [were alike], and their plans alike and their entrances alike.

21680.label: Ezekiel 42:12
21680.text: And like the entrances of the dining rooms that were toward the south was the entrance at the head of the way, the way before the corresponding stone wall toward the east, when one comes in to them.

21681.label: Ezekiel 42:13
21681.text: And he proceeded to say to me: “The dining rooms of the north [and] the dining rooms of the south that are before the separated area, they are the holy dining rooms, where the priests who are approaching Jehovah eat the most holy things. There they deposit the most holy things and the grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering, because the place is holy.

21682.label: Ezekiel 42:14
21682.text: When they, the priests, have come in, they will not also go out from the holy place to the outer courtyard, but there they will deposit their garments in which they customarily minister, for they are something holy. They will clothe themselves with other garments, and must approach to what has to do with the people.”

21683.label: Ezekiel 42:15
21683.text: And he finished the measurements of the inner house, and he brought me out by the way of the gate the front of which was toward the east, and he measured it all around.

21684.label: Ezekiel 42:16
21684.text: He measured the eastern side with the measuring reed. It was five hundred reeds, by the measuring reed, round about.

21685.label: Ezekiel 42:17
21685.text: He measured the northern side, five hundred reeds, by the measuring reed, round about.

21686.label: Ezekiel 42:18
21686.text: The southern side he measured, five hundred reeds, by the measuring reed.

21687.label: Ezekiel 42:19
21687.text: He went around to the western side. He measured five hundred reeds, by the measuring reed.

21688.label: Ezekiel 42:20
21688.text: For the four sides he measured it. It had a wall all around, with a length of five hundred [reeds] and a width of five hundred [reeds], to make a division between what is holy and what is profane.

21689.label: Ezekiel 43:1
21689.text: Then he made me go to the gate, the gate that is facing toward the east.

21690.label: Ezekiel 43:2
21690.text: And, look! the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the direction of the east, and his voice was like the voice of vast waters; and the earth itself shone because of his glory.

21691.label: Ezekiel 43:3
21691.text: And it was like the appearance of the vision that I had seen, like the vision that I saw when I came to bring the city to ruin; and there were appearances like the appearance that I saw by the river Cheʹbar, and I went falling upon my face.

21692.label: Ezekiel 43:4
21692.text: And the glory of Jehovah itself came into the House by way of the gate the front of which was toward the east.

21693.label: Ezekiel 43:5
21693.text: And a spirit proceeded to raise me up and bring me into the inner courtyard, and, look! the House had become full of the glory of Jehovah.

21694.label: Ezekiel 43:6
21694.text: And I began to hear someone speaking to me out of the House, and [the] man himself had come to be standing beside me.

21695.label: Ezekiel 43:7
21695.text: And He went on to say to me: “Son of man, [this is] the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I shall reside in the midst of the sons of Israel to time indefinite; and no more will they, the house of Israel, defile my holy name, they and their kings, by their fornication and by the carcasses of their kings at their death,

21696.label: Ezekiel 43:8
21696.text: by their putting their threshold with my threshold and their doorpost beside my doorpost, with the wall between me and them. And they defiled my holy name by their detestable things that they did, so that I went exterminating them in my anger.

21697.label: Ezekiel 43:9
21697.text: Now let them remove their fornication and the carcasses of their kings far from me, and I shall certainly reside in the midst of them to time indefinite.

21698.label: Ezekiel 43:10
21698.text: “As for you, O son of man, inform the house of Israel about the House, that they may feel humiliated because of their errors, and they must measure the pattern.

21699.label: Ezekiel 43:11
21699.text: And if they actually feel humiliated because of all that they have done, the ground plan of the House, and its arrangement and its exits and its entryways, and all its ground plans and all its specifications, and all its ground plans and all its laws do you make known to them and write before their eyes, in order that they may observe all its ground plan and all its specifications and may actually carry them out.

21700.label: Ezekiel 43:12
21700.text: This is the law of the House. On the top of the mountain its entire territory all around is something most holy. Look! This is the law of the House.

21701.label: Ezekiel 43:13
21701.text: “And these are the measurements of the altar in cubits, a cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth. And [its] bottom is a cubit. And a cubit is the width. And its border is upon its lip round about, one span. And this is the base of the altar.

21702.label: Ezekiel 43:14
21702.text: And from the bottom on the floor to the lower surrounding ledge there are two cubits, and the width is one cubit. And from the small surrounding ledge to the big surrounding ledge there are four cubits, and [its] width is a cubit.

21703.label: Ezekiel 43:15
21703.text: And the altar hearth is four cubits, and out from the altar hearth and upward there are the four horns.

21704.label: Ezekiel 43:16
21704.text: And the altar hearth is twelve [cubits] in length, with twelve [cubits] of width, squared on its four sides.

21705.label: Ezekiel 43:17
21705.text: And the surrounding ledge is fourteen [cubits] in length, with fourteen [cubits] of width, on its four sides; and the border surrounding it is half a cubit, and its bottom is a cubit round about. “And its steps are facing east.”

21706.label: Ezekiel 43:18
21706.text: And he proceeded to say to me: “Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘These are the statutes of the altar on the day of its being made, in order to offer upon it whole burnt offerings and to sprinkle upon it blood.’

21707.label: Ezekiel 43:19
21707.text: “‘And you must give to the Levitical priests, who are of the offspring of Zaʹdok, the ones approaching me,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘to minister to me, a young bull, the son of [the] herd, as a sin offering.

21708.label: Ezekiel 43:20
21708.text: And you must take some of its blood and put [it] upon its four horns and upon the four corners of the surrounding ledge and upon the border round about and purify it from sin and make atonement for it.

21709.label: Ezekiel 43:21
21709.text: And you must take the young bull, the sin offering, and one must burn it in the appointed place of the House, outside the sanctuary.

21710.label: Ezekiel 43:22
21710.text: And on the second day you will bring near a buck of the goats, a sound one, as a sin offering; and they must purify the altar from sin the same as they purified [it] from sin with the young bull.’

21711.label: Ezekiel 43:23
21711.text: “‘On your making an end of the purifying from sin you will bring near a young bull, the son of [the] herd, a sound one, and a ram from the flock, a sound one.

21712.label: Ezekiel 43:24
21712.text: And you must bring them near before Jehovah, and the priests must throw salt upon them and offer them up as a whole burnt offering to Jehovah.

21713.label: Ezekiel 43:25
21713.text: For seven days you will render up a he-goat as a sin offering for the day; and a young bull, the son of [the] herd, and a ram out of the flock, perfect ones, they will render up.

21714.label: Ezekiel 43:26
21714.text: For seven days they will make atonement for the altar, and they must cleanse it and install it.

21715.label: Ezekiel 43:27
21715.text: And they will complete the days. And it must occur on the eighth day and from then on that the priests will render upon the altar the whole burnt offerings of YOU people and YOUR communion sacrifices; and I shall certainly find pleasure in YOU,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.”

21716.label: Ezekiel 44:1
21716.text: And he proceeded to bring me back by way of the gate of the sanctuary, the outer one facing east, and it was shut.

21717.label: Ezekiel 44:2
21717.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “As regards this gate, shut is how it will continue. It will not be opened, and no mere man will come in by it; for Jehovah himself, the God of Israel, has come in by it, and it must continue shut.

21718.label: Ezekiel 44:3
21718.text: However, the chieftain —as chieftain he himself will sit in it, in order to eat bread before Jehovah. By way of the porch of the gate he will come in, and by way of it he will go out.”

21719.label: Ezekiel 44:4
21719.text: And he now brought me by way of the north gate to before the House, that I might see, and, look! the glory of Jehovah had filled the house of Jehovah. And I went falling on my face.

21720.label: Ezekiel 44:5
21720.text: Then Jehovah said to me: “Son of man, set your heart and see with your eyes, and with your ears hear all that I am speaking with you regarding all the statutes of the house of Jehovah and regarding all its laws, and you must set your heart upon the entryway of the House with all the exits of the sanctuary.

21721.label: Ezekiel 44:6
21721.text: And you must say to Rebelliousness, to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “That is enough of YOU because of all YOUR detestable things, O house of Israel,

21722.label: Ezekiel 44:7
21722.text: when YOU bring in the foreigners uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, in order to come to be in my sanctuary so as to profane it, even my house; when YOU present my bread, fat and blood, while they keep breaking my covenant on account of all YOUR detestable things.

21723.label: Ezekiel 44:8
21723.text: Neither have YOU taken care of the obligation of my holy things, nor would YOU post [others] as caretakers of my obligation in my sanctuary for yourselves.”’

21724.label: Ezekiel 44:9
21724.text: “‘This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, may come into my sanctuary, that is, any foreigner who is in the midst of the sons of Israel.”’

21725.label: Ezekiel 44:10
21725.text: “‘But as for the Levites who got far away from me when Israel, who wandered away from me, wandered after their dungy idols, they must also bear their error.

21726.label: Ezekiel 44:11
21726.text: And in my sanctuary they must become ministers at posts of oversight over the gates of the House and ministers at the House. They themselves will slaughter the whole burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they themselves will stand before them to minister to them.

21727.label: Ezekiel 44:12
21727.text: For the reason that they kept ministering to them before their dungy idols and became to the house of Israel a stumbling block into error, that is why I have raised my hand against them,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, ‘and they must bear their error.

21728.label: Ezekiel 44:13
21728.text: And they will not approach to me to act as priest to me or to approach to any holy things of mine, to the most holy things, and they must bear their humiliation and their detestable things that they did.

21729.label: Ezekiel 44:14
21729.text: And I shall certainly make them caretakers of the obligation of the House, as regards all its service and as regards all that should be done in it.’

21730.label: Ezekiel 44:15
21730.text: “‘And as for the Levitical priests, the sons of Zaʹdok, who took care of the obligation of my sanctuary when the sons of Israel wandered away from me, they themselves will come near to me to minister to me, and they must stand before me to present to me fat and the blood,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21731.label: Ezekiel 44:16
21731.text: ‘They are the ones that will come into my sanctuary, and they themselves will come near to my table to minister to me, and they must take care of the obligation to me.

21732.label: Ezekiel 44:17
21732.text: “‘And it must occur that when they come into the gates of the inner courtyard, linen garments they should wear, and no wool should come up on them when they minister in the gates of the inner courtyard and inside.

21733.label: Ezekiel 44:18
21733.text: Linen headdresses are what should prove to be on their head, and linen drawers are what should prove to be upon their hips. They should not gird themselves with [what causes] sweat.

21734.label: Ezekiel 44:19
21734.text: And when they go forth to the outer courtyard, [even] to the outer courtyard to the people, they should strip off their garments in which they were ministering, and they must deposit them in the holy dining rooms and put on other garments, that they may not sanctify the people with their garments.

21735.label: Ezekiel 44:20
21735.text: And their head they should not shave, and the hair of the head they should not wear loose. They should by all means clip [the hair of] their heads.

21736.label: Ezekiel 44:21
21736.text: And no wine should any priests drink when they come into the inner courtyard.

21737.label: Ezekiel 44:22
21737.text: And no widow or divorced woman should they take for themselves as wives, but virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel or the widow who happens to be the widow of a priest they may take.’

21738.label: Ezekiel 44:23
21738.text: “‘And my people they should instruct in the difference between a holy thing and a profane thing; and the difference between what is unclean and what is clean they should cause them to know.

21739.label: Ezekiel 44:24
21739.text: And in a legal case they themselves should stand in order to judge; with my judicial decisions they must also judge it. And my laws and my statutes in regard to all my festal seasons they should keep, and my sabbaths they should sanctify.

21740.label: Ezekiel 44:25
21740.text: And to a dead person of mankind he should not come in so as to become unclean, but for father or for mother or for son or for daughter [or] for brother or for a sister that has not become a husband’s they may make themselves unclean.

21741.label: Ezekiel 44:26
21741.text: And after his purification, seven days they should number off for him.

21742.label: Ezekiel 44:27
21742.text: And on the day of his coming into the holy place, into the inner courtyard, to minister in the holy place, he should present his sin offering,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21743.label: Ezekiel 44:28
21743.text: “‘And it must become theirs as an inheritance: I am their inheritance. And no possession should YOU people give them in Israel: I am their possession.

21744.label: Ezekiel 44:29
21744.text: The grain offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering—they are the ones who will eat them. And every devoted thing in Israel—theirs it will become.

21745.label: Ezekiel 44:30
21745.text: And the first of all the first ripe fruits of everything and every contribution of everything out of all YOUR contributions—to the priests it will come to belong; and the firstfruits of YOUR coarse meals YOU should give to the priest, in order to cause a blessing to rest upon your house.

21746.label: Ezekiel 44:31
21746.text: No body [already] dead and no creature torn to pieces of the flying creatures or of the beasts should the priests eat.’

21747.label: Ezekiel 45:1
21747.text: “‘And when YOU people allot the land as an inheritance, YOU should offer a contribution to Jehovah, a holy portion out of the land; as to length, twenty-five thousand [cubits] in length, and as to width, ten thousand. It will be a holy portion in all its boundaries round about.

21748.label: Ezekiel 45:2
21748.text: From this there will prove to be for the holy place five hundred by five hundred, it being made square round about; and fifty cubits it will have as pasture ground on each side.

21749.label: Ezekiel 45:3
21749.text: And out of this measurement you should measure the length of twenty-five thousand and the width of ten thousand, and in it the sanctuary will come to be, something most holy.

21750.label: Ezekiel 45:4
21750.text: As a holy portion out of the land it will come to be for the priests themselves, the ministers of the sanctuary, those approaching to minister to Jehovah. And for them it must prove to be a place for houses, and a sacred place for the sanctuary.

21751.label: Ezekiel 45:5
21751.text: “‘There will be twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width. It will become the Levites’, the ministers of the house. As a possession they will have twenty dining rooms.

21752.label: Ezekiel 45:6
21752.text: “‘And as the possession of the city, YOU people will give five thousand in width and a length of twenty-five thousand, exactly as the holy contribution. To all the house of Israel it will come to belong.

21753.label: Ezekiel 45:7
21753.text: “‘And for the chieftain there will be on this side and on that side of the holy contribution and of the possession of the city, beside the holy contribution and beside the possession of the city, something on the west side westward and something on the east side eastward. And the length will be exactly as one of the shares, from the western boundary to the eastern boundary.

21754.label: Ezekiel 45:8
21754.text: As regards the land, it will become his as a possession in Israel. And no more will my chieftains maltreat my people, and the land they will give to the house of Israel with respect to their tribes.’

21755.label: Ezekiel 45:9
21755.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘That is enough of YOU, O chieftains of Israel!’ “‘Remove the violence and the despoiling, and do justice and righteousness themselves. Lift YOUR expropriations off my people,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21756.label: Ezekiel 45:10
21756.text: ‘Accurate scales and an accurate eʹphah and an accurate bath measure YOU men should come to have.

21757.label: Ezekiel 45:11
21757.text: As regards the eʹphah and the bath measure, there should come to be but one fixed amount, for the bath to carry a tenth of a hoʹmer and the tenth of the hoʹmer an eʹphah; with reference to the hoʹmer, its required amount should prove to be.

21758.label: Ezekiel 45:12
21758.text: And the shekel is twenty geʹrahs. Twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, fifteen shekels should prove to be the maʹneh for YOU.’

21759.label: Ezekiel 45:13
21759.text: “‘This is the contribution that YOU should offer, the sixth part of the eʹphah from the hoʹmer of wheat, and the sixth part of the eʹphah from the hoʹmer of barley;

21760.label: Ezekiel 45:14
21760.text: and as for the allowance of the oil, there is the bath measure of the oil. The bath is a tenth of the cor. Ten baths are a hoʹmer; because ten baths are a hoʹmer.

21761.label: Ezekiel 45:15
21761.text: And one sheep out of the flock, out of two hundred from the livestock of Israel, for the grain offering and for the whole burnt offering and for the communion sacrifices, in order to make atonement for them,’ is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21762.label: Ezekiel 45:16
21762.text: “‘As for all the people of the land, they will be responsible for this contribution to the chieftain in Israel.

21763.label: Ezekiel 45:17
21763.text: And upon the chieftain will devolve the whole burnt offerings and the grain offering and the drink offering during the festivals and during the new moons and during the sabbaths, during all the festal seasons of the house of Israel. He will be the one to provide the sin offering and the grain offering and the whole burnt offering and the communion sacrifices, in order to make atonement in behalf of the house of Israel.’

21764.label: Ezekiel 45:18
21764.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘In the first [month], on the first [day] of the month, you should take a young bull, a son of the herd, a sound one, and you must purify the sanctuary from sin.

21765.label: Ezekiel 45:19
21765.text: And the priest must take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it upon the doorpost of the House and upon the four corners of the surrounding ledge belonging to the altar and upon the doorpost of the gate of the inner courtyard.

21766.label: Ezekiel 45:20
21766.text: And that is how you will do on the seventh [day] in the month because of any man making a mistake and because of any inexperienced one; and YOU people must make atonement for the House.

21767.label: Ezekiel 45:21
21767.text: “‘In the first [month], on the fourteenth day of the month, there should occur for YOU the passover. As a festival for seven days unfermented cakes are what should be eaten.

21768.label: Ezekiel 45:22
21768.text: And on that day, in his own behalf and in behalf of all the people of the land, the chieftain must provide a young bull as a sin offering.

21769.label: Ezekiel 45:23
21769.text: And for the seven days of the festival he should provide as a whole burnt offering to Jehovah seven young bulls and seven rams, sound ones, daily for the seven days, and as a sin offering a buck of the goats daily.

21770.label: Ezekiel 45:24
21770.text: And as a grain offering an eʹphah for the young bull and an eʹphah for the ram he should provide, and, as regards oil, a hin to the eʹphah.

21771.label: Ezekiel 45:25
21771.text: “‘In the seventh [month], on the fifteenth day of the month, during the festival, he should provide the same as these for the seven days, the same as the sin offering, as the whole burnt offering, and as the grain offering and as the oil.’”

21772.label: Ezekiel 46:1
21772.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘As regards the gate of the inner courtyard that is facing east, it should continue shut for the six workdays, and on the sabbath day it should be opened, and on the day of the new moon it should be opened.

21773.label: Ezekiel 46:2
21773.text: And the chieftain must come in by the way of the porch of the gate, from outside, and stand by the doorpost of the gate; and the priests must render up his whole burnt offering and his communion sacrifices, and he must bow down upon the threshold of the gate, and he must go out, but the gate itself should not be shut until the evening.

21774.label: Ezekiel 46:3
21774.text: And the people of the land must bow down at the entrance of that gate on the sabbaths and on the new moons, before Jehovah.

21775.label: Ezekiel 46:4
21775.text: “‘And the whole burnt offering that the chieftain should present to Jehovah on the sabbath day should be six sound male lambs and a sound ram;

21776.label: Ezekiel 46:5
21776.text: and as a grain offering an eʹphah for the ram, and for the male lambs a grain offering as he is able to give, and, as regards oil, a hin to the eʹphah.

21777.label: Ezekiel 46:6
21777.text: And on the day of the new moon there should be a young bull, the son of the herd, a sound one, and six male lambs and a ram; sound ones they should prove to be.

21778.label: Ezekiel 46:7
21778.text: And an eʹphah for the young bull and an eʹphah for the ram he should render up as a grain offering, and for the male lambs according to what he is able to afford; and, as regards oil, a hin to the eʹphah.

21779.label: Ezekiel 46:8
21779.text: “‘And when the chieftain comes in, by the way of the porch of the gate he should come in, and by the way of it he should go out.

21780.label: Ezekiel 46:9
21780.text: And when the people of the land come in before Jehovah in the festal seasons, the one coming in by the way of the north gate in order to bow down should go out by the way of the south gate; and the one coming in by the way of the south gate should go out by the way of the gate to the north. No one should go back by the way of the gate by which he came in, for he should go out straight ahead of him.

21781.label: Ezekiel 46:10
21781.text: And as regards the chieftain in their midst, when they come in, he should come in; and when they go out, he should go out.

21782.label: Ezekiel 46:11
21782.text: And in the festivals and in the festal seasons the grain offering should prove to be an eʹphah for the young bull and an eʹphah for the ram, and for the male lambs as he is able to give; and, as regards oil, a hin to the eʹphah.

21783.label: Ezekiel 46:12
21783.text: “‘And in case the chieftain should provide as a voluntary offering a whole burnt offering, or communion sacrifices as a voluntary offering to Jehovah, one must also open to him the gate that is facing east, and he must provide his whole burnt offering and his communion sacrifices just as he does on the sabbath day. And he must go out, and one must shut the gate after his going out.

21784.label: Ezekiel 46:13
21784.text: “‘And a sound male lamb, in its first year, you should provide as a whole burnt offering daily to Jehovah. Morning by morning you should provide it.

21785.label: Ezekiel 46:14
21785.text: And as a grain offering you should provide with it morning by morning the sixth of an eʹphah and, as regards oil, the third of a hin for sprinkling the fine flour. The grain offering to Jehovah is an indefinitely lasting statute, constantly.

21786.label: Ezekiel 46:15
21786.text: And they must provide the male lamb and the grain offering and the oil morning by morning as a constant whole burnt offering.’

21787.label: Ezekiel 46:16
21787.text: “This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said, ‘In case the chieftain should give a gift to each one of his sons as his inheritance, it itself will become the property of his sons themselves. It is their possession by inheritance.

21788.label: Ezekiel 46:17
21788.text: And in case he should give a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it must also become his until the year of liberty; and it must return to the chieftain. Only his inheritance—as regards his sons —is what should continue to belong to their own selves.

21789.label: Ezekiel 46:18
21789.text: And the chieftain should not take any of the inheritance of the people so as to force them out of their possession. From his own possession he should give his sons an inheritance, to the end that my people may not be scattered each one from his possession.’”

21790.label: Ezekiel 46:19
21790.text: And he proceeded to bring me in by the entryway that was by the side of the gate to the holy dining rooms, those belonging to the priests, that were facing to the north, and, look! there was a place there on both rear sides to the west.

21791.label: Ezekiel 46:20
21791.text: And he proceeded to say to me: “This is the place where the priests will boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, [and] where they will bake the grain offering, in order to carry nothing out to the outer courtyard so as to sanctify the people.”

21792.label: Ezekiel 46:21
21792.text: And he proceeded to bring me out to the outer courtyard and make me pass along to the four corner posts of the courtyard, and, look! there was a courtyard by [this] corner post of the courtyard, a courtyard by [that] corner post of the courtyard.

21793.label: Ezekiel 46:22
21793.text: At the four corner posts of the courtyard there were small courtyards, forty [cubits] in length and thirty in width. The four of them with corner structures had the same measurement.

21794.label: Ezekiel 46:23
21794.text: And there was a row round about them, round about the four of them, and there were boiling places made beneath the rows round about.

21795.label: Ezekiel 46:24
21795.text: Then he said to me: “These are the houses of those doing the boiling, where the ministers of the House boil the sacrifice of the people.”

21796.label: Ezekiel 47:1
21796.text: And gradually he brought me back to the entrance of the House, and, look! there was water going forth from under the threshold of the House eastward, for the front of the House was east. And the water was going down from under, from the right-hand side of the House, south of the altar.

21797.label: Ezekiel 47:2
21797.text: And he gradually brought me forth by the way of the north gate and took me around by the way outside to the outer gate that is facing toward the east, and, look! water was trickling from the right-hand side.

21798.label: Ezekiel 47:3
21798.text: When the man went forth eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he also proceeded to measure a thousand in cubits and to make me pass through the water, water [up] to the ankles.

21799.label: Ezekiel 47:4
21799.text: And he continued measuring a thousand and then made me pass through the water, water [up] to the knees. And he continued measuring a thousand and now made me pass through—water [up] to the hips.

21800.label: Ezekiel 47:5
21800.text: And he continued measuring a thousand. It was a torrent that I was not able to pass through, for the water had got high, water [permitting] swimming, a torrent that could not be passed through.

21801.label: Ezekiel 47:6
21801.text: At that he said to me: “Have you seen [this], O son of man?” Then he had me walk and had me return [to] the bank of the torrent.

21802.label: Ezekiel 47:7
21802.text: When I returned, why, look! on the bank of the torrent there were very many trees, on this side and on that side.

21803.label: Ezekiel 47:8
21803.text: And he went on to say to me: “This water is going forth to the eastern region and must go down through the Arʹa·bah. And it must come to the sea. It being brought forth into the sea itself, [its] water is also actually healed.

21804.label: Ezekiel 47:9
21804.text: And it must occur that every living soul that swarms, in every place to which the double-size torrent comes, will get life. And it must occur that there will be very many fish, because there is where this water will certainly come, and the [seawater] will be healed, and everything will be alive where the torrent comes.

21805.label: Ezekiel 47:10
21805.text: “And it must occur that fishers will actually stand alongside it from En-geʹdi even up to En-egʹla·im. There will come to be a drying yard for dragnets. In their kinds their fish will prove to be, like the fish of the Great Sea, very many.

21806.label: Ezekiel 47:11
21806.text: “There are its swampy places and its marshy places, and they will not be healed. To salt they will certainly be given.

21807.label: Ezekiel 47:12
21807.text: “And alongside the torrent there will come up, along its bank on this side and on that side, all sorts of trees for food. Their leafage will not wither, nor will their fruitage be consumed. In their months they will bear new fruit, because the water for them—it is coming forth from the very sanctuary. And their fruitage must prove to be for food and their leafage for healing.”

21808.label: Ezekiel 47:13
21808.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has said: “This is the territory that YOU will assign to yourselves for inheritance as the land for the twelve tribes of Israel, with two pieces of field to Joseph.

21809.label: Ezekiel 47:14
21809.text: And YOU people must inherit it, each one the same as his brother, which [land] I raised my hand [in an oath] to give to YOUR forefathers; and this land must fall to YOU [by lot] for inheritance.

21810.label: Ezekiel 47:15
21810.text: “And this is the boundary of the land to the northern side, from the Great Sea by the way to Hethʹlon, as one comes to Zeʹdad,

21811.label: Ezekiel 47:16
21811.text: Haʹmath, Be·roʹthah, Sibʹra·im, which is between the boundary of Damascus and the boundary of Haʹmath; Haʹzer-hatʹti·con, which is toward the boundary of Ha·u·ranʹ.

21812.label: Ezekiel 47:17
21812.text: And the boundary from the sea must prove to be Haʹzar-eʹnon, the boundary of Damascus and north—northward, and the boundary of Haʹmath. This is the northern side.

21813.label: Ezekiel 47:18
21813.text: “And the eastern side is from between Ha·u·ranʹ and Damascus and between Gilʹe·ad and the land of Israel; the Jordan, from the boundary to the eastern sea YOU people should measure. This is the eastern side.

21814.label: Ezekiel 47:19
21814.text: “And the southern side is to the south, from Taʹmar to the waters of Merʹi·bath-kaʹdesh, the torrent valley to the Great Sea. This is the side to the south, toward the Negʹeb.

21815.label: Ezekiel 47:20
21815.text: “And the western side is the Great Sea, from the boundary straight ahead to the entering in to Haʹmath. This is the western side.”

21816.label: Ezekiel 47:21
21816.text: “And YOU must apportion this land to yourselves, to the twelve tribes of Israel.

21817.label: Ezekiel 47:22
21817.text: And it must occur that YOU should allot it for inheritance to yourselves and to the alien residents who are residing as aliens in YOUR midst, who have become father to sons in the midst of YOU. And they must become to YOU like a native among the sons of Israel. With YOU people they will fall [by lot] into an inheritance in the midst of the tribes of Israel.

21818.label: Ezekiel 47:23
21818.text: And it must occur that in the tribe with which the alien resident has taken up residence as an alien, there is where YOU should give his inheritance,” is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21819.label: Ezekiel 48:1
21819.text: “And these are the names of the tribes. From the northern extremity, on the side by the way of Hethʹlon to the entering in to Haʹmath, Haʹzar-eʹnan, the boundary of Damascus northward, on the side of Haʹmath; and it must prove to have an eastern border [and] the western, Dan one [portion].

21820.label: Ezekiel 48:2
21820.text: And on the boundary of Dan, from the eastern border to the western border, Ashʹer one.

21821.label: Ezekiel 48:3
21821.text: And on the boundary of Ashʹer, from the eastern border even to the western border, Naphʹta·li one.

21822.label: Ezekiel 48:4
21822.text: And on the boundary of Naphʹta·li, from the eastern border to the western border, Ma·nasʹseh one.

21823.label: Ezekiel 48:5
21823.text: And on the boundary of Ma·nasʹseh, from the eastern border to the western border, Eʹphra·im one.

21824.label: Ezekiel 48:6
21824.text: And on the boundary of Eʹphra·im, from the eastern border even to the western border, Reuʹben one.

21825.label: Ezekiel 48:7
21825.text: And on the boundary of Reuʹben, from the eastern border to the western border, Judah one.

21826.label: Ezekiel 48:8
21826.text: And on the boundary of Judah, from the eastern border to the western border, the contribution that YOU people should contribute should prove to be twenty-five thousand [cubits] in width, and [the] length according to one of the portions from the eastern border to the western border. And the sanctuary must prove to be in the midst of it.

21827.label: Ezekiel 48:9
21827.text: “As regards the contribution that YOU should contribute to Jehovah, [the] length will be twenty-five thousand [cubits] and [the] width ten thousand.

21828.label: Ezekiel 48:10
21828.text: And as to these there should prove to be the holy contribution for the priests, to the north twenty-five thousand [cubits], and to the west a width of ten thousand, and to the east a width of ten thousand, and to the south a length of twenty-five thousand. And the sanctuary of Jehovah must prove to be in the midst of it.

21829.label: Ezekiel 48:11
21829.text: It will be for the priests, those who are sanctified from the sons of Zaʹdok, who took care of the obligation toward me, who did not wander away when the sons of Israel wandered away, just as the Levites wandered away.

21830.label: Ezekiel 48:12
21830.text: And they must come to have a contribution from the contribution of the land as something most holy, on the boundary of the Levites.

21831.label: Ezekiel 48:13
21831.text: “And the Levites should have, right next to the territory of the priests, twenty-five thousand [cubits] in length, and in width ten thousand; the whole length being twenty-five thousand and width being ten thousand.

21832.label: Ezekiel 48:14
21832.text: And they should not sell any of it, nor should one make an exchange, nor should one cause the choicest of the land to pass away [from them]; for it is something holy to Jehovah.

21833.label: Ezekiel 48:15
21833.text: “As regards the five thousand [cubits] that is left remaining in width alongside the twenty-five thousand, it is something profane for the city, for a dwelling place and for pasture ground. And the city must come to be in the midst of it.

21834.label: Ezekiel 48:16
21834.text: And these are the [city’s] measurements: the northern border four thousand five hundred [cubits], and the southern border four thousand five hundred, and the eastern border four thousand five hundred, and the western border four thousand five hundred.

21835.label: Ezekiel 48:17
21835.text: And the city must come to have a pasture ground, to the north two hundred and fifty [cubits], and to the south two hundred and fifty, and to the east two hundred and fifty, and to the west two hundred and fifty.

21836.label: Ezekiel 48:18
21836.text: “And what is left remaining over in length will be exactly as the holy contribution, ten thousand [cubits] to the east, and ten thousand to the west; and it must prove to be exactly as the holy contribution, and its produce must come to be for bread for the ones serving the city.

21837.label: Ezekiel 48:19
21837.text: And those who are serving the city out of all the tribes of Israel will cultivate it.

21838.label: Ezekiel 48:20
21838.text: “The whole contribution is twenty-five thousand [cubits] by twenty-five thousand. A foursquare part YOU people should contribute as the holy contribution with the possession of the city.

21839.label: Ezekiel 48:21
21839.text: “And what is left over will belong to the chieftain, on this side and on that side of the holy contribution and of the possession of the city, alongside the twenty-five thousand [cubits] [of] the contribution to the eastern boundary; and on the west alongside the twenty-five thousand [cubits] to the western boundary. Exactly like the portions, [it will be] for the chieftain. And the holy contribution and the sanctuary of the House must prove to be in the midst of it.

21840.label: Ezekiel 48:22
21840.text: “And as regards the possession of the Levites and the possession of the city, in between what belongs to the chieftain it should prove to be. Between the boundary of Judah and the boundary of Benjamin it should come to belong to the chieftain.

21841.label: Ezekiel 48:23
21841.text: “And as regards the rest of the tribes, from the eastern border to the western border, Benjamin one [portion].

21842.label: Ezekiel 48:24
21842.text: And by the boundary of Benjamin, from the eastern border to the western border, Simʹe·on one.

21843.label: Ezekiel 48:25
21843.text: And by the boundary of Simʹe·on, from the eastern border to the western border, Isʹsa·char one.

21844.label: Ezekiel 48:26
21844.text: And by the boundary of Isʹsa·char, from the eastern border to the western border, Zebʹu·lun one.

21845.label: Ezekiel 48:27
21845.text: And by the boundary of Zebʹu·lun, from the eastern border to the western border, Gad one.

21846.label: Ezekiel 48:28
21846.text: And by the boundary of Gad, to the southern border, it will be southward; and the boundary must prove to be from Taʹmar to the waters of Merʹi·bath-kaʹdesh, to the torrent valley, as far as the Great Sea.

21847.label: Ezekiel 48:29
21847.text: “This will be the land that YOU people should cause to fall [by lot] for inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their shares,” is the utterance of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah.

21848.label: Ezekiel 48:30
21848.text: “And these will be the outlets of the city: On the northern border, four thousand five hundred [cubits] will be [the] measurement.

21849.label: Ezekiel 48:31
21849.text: “And the gates of the city will be according to the names of the tribes of Israel, three gates being on the north, the gate of Reuʹben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Leʹvi, one.

21850.label: Ezekiel 48:32
21850.text: “And on the eastern border there will be four thousand five hundred [cubits], and three gates, even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

21851.label: Ezekiel 48:33
21851.text: “And the southern border will be four thousand five hundred [cubits] as to measurement, with three gates, the gate of Simʹe·on, one; the gate of Isʹsa·char, one; the gate of Zebʹu·lun, one.

21852.label: Ezekiel 48:34
21852.text: “The western border will be four thousand five hundred [cubits], there being three gates, the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Ashʹer, one; the gate of Naphʹta·li, one.

21853.label: Ezekiel 48:35
21853.text: “Round about [there will be] eighteen thousand [cubits]; and the name of the city from [that] day on will be Jehovah Himself Is There.”
